comment: AI labels per PMID (see ai_labels/PROMPT.md). Side file: not applied to the site until a reviewed step does so.

26352083.takeaway: Four brothers sharing an Xq27.1 duplication containing SOX3 showed widely varying pituitary hormone deficiency, from multiple deficiencies to none, with or without facial dysmorphism.

27760014.takeaway: Most Israeli youth with type 1 diabetes had vitamin D insufficiency or deficiency; levels were lowest in winter and were associated with BMI and clothing habits.

28216084.takeaway: Vitamin D supplementation doses are recommended to vary by age, body weight, disease status and ethnicity, ranging from 400 to 2000 IU per day.

29389666.takeaway: Children with hypothalamic obesity had higher fasting triglycerides, more metabolic syndrome and hyperphagia, and higher fasting and 120-minute GLP-1 than matched simple obesity controls.

29504223.takeaway: Australasian consensus guideline grading evidence for bisphosphonate use in children, covering osteogenesis imperfecta, secondary osteoporosis and non-fragility bone conditions.

29982476.takeaway: Endocrine Society guideline on diagnosing and treating hypothalamic-pituitary and growth disorders in childhood cancer survivors, who face lifelong endocrine risk after radiation.

30033107.takeaway: Spanish multidisciplinary guideline on differences of sex development, covering diagnosis, sex assignment, hormone replacement, surgery, psychosocial support and transition.

30091950.takeaway: A girl developed arterial hypertension during triptorelin treatment for central precocious puberty that normalized after therapy stopped; the authors suggest routine blood pressure monitoring.

30180972.takeaway: Recommendations for pediatric Graves' disease: antithyroid drugs are first-line over several years, propylthiouracil is contraindicated, and surgery is reserved for children under 5 or with large goiters.

30209800.takeaway: Polish consensus on PCOS: Rotterdam criteria for adults, menstrual disturbance plus hyperandrogenism for teenagers, and therapy tailored to the metabolic, hyperandrogenic or reproductive phenotype.

30209801.takeaway: Polish recommendations for adult care of Prader-Willi syndrome cover obesity prevention, hormone disorders, mental health, nutrition and physiotherapy, continuing treatment started in pediatric care.

30289543.takeaway: Recommendations suggest starting adrenal function assessment at diagnosis in boys with adrenoleukodystrophy found on newborn screen, with regular monitoring to catch adrenal insufficiency before crisis.

30782004.takeaway: NMR spectroscopy measured insulin concentration and structural integrity in public-use insulin products, finding correct concentrations in all samples but variable sample quality by type and manufacturer.

30862242.takeaway: A quality-improvement hybrid closed-loop training program for 72 pediatric pump users, with group class, video teaching and follow-up calls, was rated highly and supported sustained early use.

30929401.takeaway: A preterm newborn with persistently low alkaline phosphatase, rickets-like radiographic changes and a novel heterozygous ALPL variant likely had an atypical mild neonatal hypophosphatasia.

30968677.takeaway: Narrative review of human imprinting disorders, which are underdiagnosed because of overlapping, mild and age-dependent signs, with endocrine features highlighted for pediatrics.

30968679.takeaway: Two 46,XX siblings with a novel CYP19A1 variant had aromatase deficiency and were raised as different genders; the authors advise testing virilised 46,XX girls for it after excluding CAH.

31088041.takeaway: A 7-year-old girl with NF1-Noonan features had abnormal external genitalia caused by a diffuse genital plexiform neurofibroma, with normal karyotype and hormone testing.

31113238.takeaway: Semistructured interviews with 12 adults with type 1 diabetes shaped a CGM guidance leaflet, showing that people need personalized information on using CGM in their own self-management.

31113250.takeaway: In 130 adults and adolescents with type 1 diabetes, a prefilled insulin cartridge gave higher satisfaction, shorter pump preparation and training time, and less residual air than self-filling a reservoir.

31117334.takeaway: A patient with Carney complex without typical skin lesions presented with a bone tumor, later diagnosed with a calcifying Sertoli cell tumor and precocious puberty, and a PRKAR1A variant.

31154502.takeaway: In 75 children, ACR TI-RADS gave better inter-rater agreement than Kwak TI-RADS, but both had similar moderate accuracy for thyroid malignancy, so pediatric adjustment is needed.

31195397.takeaway: A stepwise approach to growth failure: clinical assessment, then bone-age X-ray and screening labs, then molecular array rather than karyotype for short girls, and targeted testing if indicated.

31208160.takeaway: A 12-year-old boy with neurofibromatosis type 1 and asymptomatic pheochromocytoma presented with catecholamine-induced myocarditis, showing cardiomyopathy can be the first sign of the tumor.

31208161.takeaway: A patient with 46,XY disorder of sex development and adrenal hypoplasia had MIRAGE syndrome from a novel heterozygous SAMD9 variant; the report describes the first such case in Turkey.

31216873.takeaway: In insulin-requiring pregnancies, women using cellular-enabled glucometers had lower HbA1c at delivery than standard-meter users (5.8% vs 6.3%), with no difference in neonatal outcomes.

31227585.takeaway: Adding supervised exercise to a family lifestyle program reduced hepatic fat in children with overweight, while both groups reduced BMI, fat mass and insulin.

31302655.takeaway: A proposed flow chart for children referred for tall stature or accelerated growth uses history, examination, growth analysis and targeted labs and genetic tests to find treatable causes.

31308020.takeaway: In 107 youth with type 1 diabetes, prepubertal youth had greater glucose variability than pubertal or postpubertal youth at similar HbA1c, so CGM adds information beyond HbA1c.

31315446.takeaway: Protocol for ViDiKi, a multicenter controlled trial testing monthly video consultations for children with type 1 diabetes using CGM, with HbA1c as the primary outcome; results are not yet reported.

31319416.takeaway: International consortium narrative review of GnRH analog use in children, covering precocious puberty diagnosis, formulations, monitoring, adverse events, transgender use and the paucity of evidence.

31339256.takeaway: In 87 obese children, higher serum nesfatin-1 was an independent predictor of hypertension, with a cut-off above 1.8 ng/mL giving 96.7% sensitivity and 71.9% specificity.

31347350.takeaway: In 220 girls with idiopathic central precocious puberty, monthly 3.75 mg leuprolide suppressed the axis in 88.6%; weight of 36 kg or more and BMI-SDS of 1.6 or more predicted need for 7.5 mg.

31375031.takeaway: Two OneTouch meter systems met ISO 15197:2015 accuracy standards across a wide glucose range, and users in a one-week trial valued the personalized guidance and color range features.

31414586.takeaway: Metabolically unhealthy obese children had lower thiol and higher disulfide and ischemia-modified albumin than healthy controls, suggesting greater oxidative imbalance.

31434460.takeaway: Among 200 children with type 1 diabetes, metabolic syndrome prevalence was 8.5% to 13.5% depending on criteria, and 38.8% to 44.4% in those with overweight or obesity; the authors favor IDF criteria.

31434461.takeaway: In obese children with metabolic syndrome, macular retinal thickness and volume fell as BMI-SDS, waist and insulin resistance rose, and inflammatory indices NLR and SIII were linked to macular damage.

31434462.takeaway: Narrative review of childhood lipodystrophy, which causes insulin resistance, diabetes, hypertriglyceridemia and liver disease; newer treatments such as metreleptin are discussed and specialist care is advised.

31441324.takeaway: In a survey of 289 adults with type 1 diabetes, pumps and CGM interfered with sex for many users and influenced device choice, but sexual behavior, anxiety and body image did not differ by use.

31448769.takeaway: A boy with a novel IGSF1 variant had mild central hypothyroidism; undetectable prolactin was the clue, which thyroid tests alone could have missed.

31448886.takeaway: A 4-year-old boy with pituitary stalk interruption syndrome and multiple pituitary hormone deficiencies carried a novel ROBO1 missense variant, also found in his mother, who had pituitary abnormalities.

31448952.takeaway: Home video visits over a year for 57 children and adolescents with uncontrolled type 1 diabetes lowered mean HbA1c from 10.8% to 10.0% and raised completion of annual clinic visits from 21% to 83%.

31464516.takeaway: Of 18 children with skin reactions to diabetes devices, two-thirds had positive patch tests, most often to colophonium in device adhesives; the authors call for manufacturer disclosure and stricter labeling.

31475508.takeaway: In 74 children with PSIS-related multiple pituitary hormone deficiency, growth velocity in the first year of GH treatment predicted final height; 23 reached adult height.

31475509.takeaway: Bisphenol A was detected in 76.8% of 125 preschool children in Ankara, and the authors estimate daily intake well below the EFSA tolerable limit.

31475510.takeaway: In peripubertal female rats, high-dose 5-hydroxymethylfurfural caused earlier vaginal opening, higher LH and estradiol, lower AMH, and precocious puberty.

31475511.takeaway: An updated free online toolset adds growth references for children with Prader-Willi, Noonan, Turner, Down syndrome and achondroplasia, plus newborns and 24-hour blood pressure norms.

31476840.takeaway: An SRY-negative 46,XX ovotesticular DSD patient carried a 1.1 Mb duplication upstream of SOX9 on 17q24.3, the first such case reported from Turkey.

31484666.takeaway: Of 71 adults with type 1 diabetes and impaired hypoglycemia awareness, 39% kept having recurrent severe hypoglycemia over 2 years; these incomplete responders used less insulin and had worse awareness.

31486329.takeaway: Among 107 children with chronic liver disease, about 10% had subclinical hypothyroidism or euthyroid sick syndrome, so the authors recommend thyroid testing at diagnosis and follow-up.

31486330.takeaway: In a survey of 140 physicians and 30 parents, physician knowledge of Turner syndrome was poor, with 67% of physicians unaware of its incidence and most parents unaware of associated risks.

31498940.takeaway: In 105 children with type 1 diabetes, obese participants spent less time in REM sleep than non-obese peers, while slow-wave sleep did not differ by BMI.

31514194.takeaway: International Growth Hormone Research Society workshop consensus on short stature: history, examination and auxology remain central, while genetic testing and GH dosing and response remain debated.

31514489.takeaway: In 16 children with type 1 diabetes, soluble RAGE was 39% lower during DKA treatment than at later follow-up, while D-lactate rose, in keeping with known dicarbonyl increases.

31514490.takeaway: In 166 Turkish patients with hypophosphatemic rickets, higher phosphate and calcitriol doses were associated with nephrocalcinosis, while higher calcitriol doses may improve bone deformity.

31514491.takeaway: Serum irisin in 68 normal-weight pubertal boys did not differ across Tanner stages 2 to 5 and was unrelated to body fat or fat-free mass.

31517512.takeaway: A video-based group program for parents of children aged 1 to 6 with type 1 diabetes was feasible and well accepted, with 21% attrition, 94% session attendance and 89% satisfaction.

31529059.takeaway: In 42 healthy young men, microdialysis tracked free cortisol in blood, subcutaneous tissue and saliva; cortisol rose after Synacthen and followed total cortisol with minimal delay.

31529070.takeaway: In 20 women with non-classic 21-hydroxylase deficiency, peak cortisol after insulin hypoglycemia was lower than in matched controls, and only 55% reached the cutoff versus all controls.

31529090.takeaway: In adults with longstanding type 1 diabetes, DKA hospitalization ran at 1.4 to 1.8 per 100 person-years; poor glucose control, pump use and kidney disease predicted it, a risk relevant to SGLT2 inhibitor use.

31529097.takeaway: In 18 women with PCOS, one month of sitagliptin lowered peak glucose and visceral fat and increased GH half-life, but did not raise overnight GH secretion.

31536623.takeaway: In a World Trade Center birth cohort, several cord-blood PFAS were associated with higher cord lipid levels, with a strong linear trend between PFOA or PFHxS and triglycerides.

31538817.takeaway: In eight patients with CGM-related contact dermatitis to isobornyl acrylate, hydrocolloid plasters under the scanned sensor let all of them keep using the device, with some limitations.

31539053.takeaway: In 14 previously sedentary young women, modest prolonged reductions in energy availability were associated with fewer LH pulses, and fewer LH pulses went with menstrual disturbances.

31544944.takeaway: Transgender adolescents on hormone therapy had body composition intermediate between BMI-matched cisgender males and females, and transgender females were more insulin resistant than cisgender males.

31544945.takeaway: Five new cases and 14 nonmosaic patients with IGF2 mutations had a Silver-Russell phenotype, with less hemihypoplasia and more feeding difficulty than H19/IGF2 epimutation cases.

31545360.takeaway: In 1156 Danish women with Turner syndrome, hormone replacement was linked to less stroke, osteoporotic fracture and antihypertensive, antidiabetic and thyroid medication use, with no clear mortality change.

31552725.takeaway: In 155 Mexican children aged 8 to 11, total adiponectin was lower in those with metabolic syndrome and correlated negatively with insulin resistance, blood pressure and fasting glucose.

31552726.takeaway: A retrospective Cyprus study of 107 children diagnosed with type 1 diabetes in 2001 to 2016 found a mean incidence of 11.1 per 100,000, stable across years and intermediate versus other countries.

31558544.takeaway: In 27,071 genotyped individuals, six HLA haplotypes and six non-HLA regions, including GLIS3, showed stronger effects on type 1 diabetes diagnosed before age 7 than on later-onset disease.

31560217.takeaway: In 12 adults with type 1 diabetes, subcutaneous glucagon given next to a Medtronic Enlite sensor did not significantly change its accuracy compared with a sensor placed remotely.

31561709.takeaway: Using published data, insulin adsorption to infusion lines rises as flow falls, and at low flow and concentration up to about 50% of intended insulin may not be delivered over 24 hours.

31568365.takeaway: ACOG guidance on the hyperandrogenic adolescent: assess hirsutism and acne, measure testosterone and screen for nonclassic CAH, and treat acne or hirsutism without waiting for a PCOS diagnosis.

31573414.takeaway: In 45 children with T3 differentiated thyroid cancer, microscopic extrathyroidal extension predicted lymph node metastasis (94% vs 46%) better than tumor size and should inform risk stratification.

31584229.takeaway: In 121 children and adolescents with diabetes in Mexico City, a 6-month multidisciplinary program raised time in range and lowered HbA1c by 1.8%, with control improving each month.

31585006.takeaway: In 134 children and adolescents, antenatal synthetic glucocorticoid exposure was not linked to long-term hair cortisol or DHEA levels, suggesting no lasting HPA-axis change by this measure.

31588494.takeaway: In seven patients with insulin receptor mutations, six months of liothyronine did not change HbA1c but increased whole-body, muscle and fat glucose uptake.

31589293.takeaway: In 148 adults with craniopharyngioma, complications were more frequent after transcranial than transsphenoidal surgery, hormone deficits worsened in 63.6%, and BMI rose after surgery.

31589350.takeaway: In 84 adolescents with type 1 diabetes, A1c was the only independent factor linked to self-rated health, and A1c mediated the link between self-care and self-rated health.

31591105.takeaway: In 438 children followed from seroconversion, some non-HLA variants (PTPN2, FUT2, CTSH, IKZF4) and HLA A*24 were linked to faster decline of first-phase insulin response in those with multiple autoantibodies.

31591761.takeaway: Type 1 diabetes incidence in Alabama children rose from 2000 to 2017 with a crude rate of 16.7 per 100,000; Black children's rate tripled over the period versus doubling for White children.

31596127.takeaway: In a randomized crossover trial of 34 campers using pumps, an algorithm that adjusted basal rates and carb ratios did not improve time in target range or reduce hypoglycemia.

31596130.takeaway: In 36 people aged 6 to 65 with type 1 diabetes, five days of Omnipod hybrid closed loop was safe and raised time in range, while time above 250 mg/dL fell in every age group.

31597639.takeaway: Histology of 78 donor pancreata showed fewer amylase-negative peri-islet acinar cell clusters in type 1 diabetes, pointing to a possible exocrine role in its pathogenesis.

31599085.takeaway: In 65 children with type 1 diabetes and poor control, 20% had a Bone Health Index SD score below -2, with lower bone turnover markers, osteocalcin, phosphorus and magnesium.

31601636.takeaway: A meta-analysis of seven cohorts (3,677 mother-newborn pairs) found two cord-blood methylation regions, one in the OR2L13 promoter, hypomethylated in newborns exposed to maternal gestational diabetes.

31601639.takeaway: Among 2,429 Colorado children with new type 1 diabetes, DKA at diagnosis rose from 41% to 58% over 2010 to 2017, with public insurance, rural residence and higher HbA1c linked to DKA.

31603351.takeaway: In 161 women with gestational diabetes, telehomecare cut medical visits by 56% with similar glucose control and complications, but raised nursing contacts about tenfold.

31603620.takeaway: Among 83 teens and young adults with type 1 diabetes, those who had incorporated diabetes into their identity reported better self-care, self-esteem and life satisfaction.

31603857.takeaway: In 78 radioactive iodine ablations for pediatric Graves' disease, 73% became hypothyroid, and smaller thyroid size and higher I-131 dose per gram were linked to hypothyroidism.

31604004.takeaway: A targeted next-generation sequencing panel of seven MODY genes in 50 Greek patients found pathogenic or likely pathogenic variants in 16%, and five novel variants were reported.

31605416.takeaway: Across 4,361 Czech children with diabetes in 2013 to 2017, median HbA1c fell from 66.3 to 61.0 mmol/mol and target attainment rose from 28% to 40%.

31608377.takeaway: In 218 Dutch twins followed to age 17, genetic factors explained 42% of cortisol production variance at age 9 but none at age 17.

31608650.takeaway: A pediatric diabetes simulator that models blood glucose and urine ketones was judged realistic, and 16 of 17 pediatric residents wanted more simulated diabetes case practice.

31608940.takeaway: In a Mexico City birth cohort of 369 children aged 10 to 18, higher maternal blood lead during pregnancy was linked to lower total and HDL cholesterol in boys.

31608942.takeaway: A survey of 232 clinicians found agreement that sperm banking should be encouraged in late puberty but not early, and 78% supported testicular biopsy if no sperm is found in the ejaculate.

31610036.takeaway: Narrative review of new genetic causes of primary adrenal insufficiency, including DAX-1, SF-1, CDKN1C, SAMD9, POLE1, nonclassic STAR and CYP11A1 defects, and SGPL1, stressing that a specific diagnosis guides management.

31610073.takeaway: In 42 parents of young children with type 1 diabetes, a 10-session video telehealth program significantly reduced hypoglycemia fear versus waitlist, with reductions maintained at 3 months.

31613320.takeaway: In 20 young women with Turner syndrome, 4 mg oral estradiol produced a steeper uterine volume gain over 3 years than 2 mg, though volumes did not differ at the last visit.

31613321.takeaway: An 18-year-old male developed acute neuropathy after rapid correction of hyperglycemia, a presentation of treatment-induced neuropathy of diabetes that should be considered in pediatric and adult patients.

31613324.takeaway: In 205 patients with Cushing's syndrome, the A3669G glucocorticoid receptor variant was linked to higher handgrip strength in active disease, with the minor allele carried by stronger patients.

31613957.takeaway: Plasma renin was unrelated to mineralocorticoid replacement dose in 243 patients with primary adrenal insufficiency, so renin alone may not guide dose titration.

31613966.takeaway: In 56 mother-infant pairs, early-pregnancy mixtures of environmental disruptors were associated with maternal and cord-blood oxidative stress markers in sex-dependent ways.

31614369.takeaway: In a Mendelian randomization study, later age at menarche was causally associated with lower coronary artery disease risk in adults, using genetic instruments from large consortia.

31617648.takeaway: In a pilot randomized peer-mentorship program for 42 publicly insured teens with type 1 diabetes, HbA1c did not differ significantly from control, though treated teens reported more hope.

31617910.takeaway: In 4,013 Danish children and adolescents, overweight or obesity raised ALT at every age, and optimal ALT cut-points for hepatic steatosis were derived.

31618523.takeaway: Retinopathy prevalence in 2,382 Danish children with type 1 diabetes was 0.9% at age 12, 2.3% at 15 and 3.1% at 18, data relevant to whether age-12 screening is still needed.

31619071.takeaway: At five-month follow-up, 81% of 138 children with pumps or CGM still had dermatological complications, with itching most common, showing no improvement.

31621408.takeaway: Pregnant women on gliclazide had no significant difference in maternal hospitalization or birth weight compared with propensity-matched metformin users, 108 per group.

31626728.takeaway: In 89 MEN1 patients with hyperparathyroidism, single gland excision had 14.2% disease persistence versus 0% to 2.6% after subtotal or total parathyroidectomy, and more recurrence.

31628116.takeaway: Among 932 adults with type 1 diabetes, moderate cannabis use was associated with higher odds of DKA in the past year (OR 2.5, 95% CI 1.0 to 5.9).

31628455.takeaway: Muscle from patients with truncating GYG1 mutations expressed neither glycogenin isoform, suggesting glycogenin is dispensable for glycogen synthesis in human muscle but its loss causes polyglucosan storage.

31628465.takeaway: In 18 healthy young men, an 8-hour peptide YY infusion did not change LH pulse number or LH secretion compared with vehicle.

31628775.takeaway: Mandatory notifications of 4,153 Chilean young people with type 1 diabetes from 2006 to 2014 showed an average incidence of 12 per 100,000, rising from 10.2 to 13.8.

31628818.takeaway: Among 96 children with type 1 diabetes aged 5 to 20, fear of hypoglycemia (76%) and low fitness (51%) were the most common barriers to exercise, with family support rated higher than social support.

31628846.takeaway: A Kallmann syndrome patient with a balanced translocation disrupting the lncRNA RMST had patient-derived cells that implicate RMST in GnRH neuron development.

31631358.takeaway: In Western Sweden, 14.1% of 223,211 people received oral glucocorticoids at adrenal-suppressing doses over eight years, including 10.6% of children aged 0 to 9.

31633765.takeaway: In 521 children from northeastern Spain, circulating IGF-1 correlated with later blood pressure and cardiometabolic markers, and independently predicted blood pressure in those with higher calcium-phosphorus product.

31635966.takeaway: Review of reproductive problems in women with diabetes, from delayed puberty and menstrual irregularity to subfertility, pregnancy complications and early menopause.

31636081.takeaway: In 16 adults with uncomplicated type 1 diabetes, lung diffusion and arterial oxygen transport were normal, but exercise-induced muscle responses were blunted compared with 16 matched controls.

31638161.takeaway: Narrative review of brown adipose tissue crosstalk, describing batokines and interactions with liver, muscle, gut and the central nervous system that shape thermogenesis and metabolic regulation.

31644828.takeaway: In 149 youth aged 12 to 21 with type 1 or type 2 diabetes, depressive symptoms were higher in type 2, and their link to poorer global health was stronger in type 2.

31648184.takeaway: A VigiBase disproportionality analysis found immune checkpoint inhibitors over-reported for hypothyroidism, hyperthyroidism, thyroiditis and thyrotoxic crisis compared with all drugs.

31649097.takeaway: In 22,335 adults with diabetes in 2011 to 2016 surveys, Medicaid expansion was associated with better self-reported access to care, diabetes management and health status than in non-expansion states.

31650172.takeaway: In 55 one-month-old infants, salivary glucocorticoids showed a biphasic daily rhythm, which the authors interpret as a developing HPA axis.

31650182.takeaway: In healthy ovulatory women aged 18 to 40, oral elagolix suppressed ovulation dose-dependently, with 78% still ovulating at the lowest dose and fewer at higher doses.

31658436.takeaway: A de novo PHEX variant in a girl with X-linked hypophosphatemic rickets was found only in her phenotypically normal father's sperm, showing germline mosaicism that matters for genetic counseling.

31658956.takeaway: Exome sequencing of 82 Chinese Han patients with clinically diagnosed, antibody-negative type 1 diabetes found credible mutations in 22%, mostly HNF1A and WFS1, suggesting about 6% have monogenic diabetes.

31658974.takeaway: A US Markov model estimated 18.2 million people living with type 2 diabetes and NAFLD, and modeled the economic and clinical burden of NASH over 20 years.

31665323.takeaway: In the CATS trial, children of mothers treated for suboptimal thyroid function had no overall difference in behavior scores, but children of overtreated mothers had more ADHD symptoms and conduct difficulties.

31665326.takeaway: In 101 short children born SGA, one year of high-dose GH pushed total IGF-I above 2 SD in 68%, while bioactive IGF stayed within the normal range for most.

31665330.takeaway: RNA sequencing and progesterone receptor ChIP-seq were run on 42 endometrial biopsies from fertile women to map receptor-regulated pathways in the implantation window.

31665337.takeaway: In children with Silver-Russell syndrome, those with maternal uniparental disomy of chromosome 7 had lower IQ, and brain volume was reduced in frontal and temporal poles and globi pallidi versus controls.

31665349.takeaway: Adults exposed to dexamethasone in early fetal life had 17% to 22% lower insulin secretion than 16 matched controls, which may predispose them to later abnormal glucose tolerance.

31665438.takeaway: The External Genitalia Score is a reliable, valid tool for describing external genitalia in preterm and term babies up to 24 months, and it correlates with anogenital distance in males.

31665455.takeaway: Among 35 adults with obesity who completed 16 weeks of liraglutide, appetite and taste preferences shifted and fat stores fell without loss of lean mass compared with placebo.

31665456.takeaway: In 172 Faroese mother-child pairs, several maternal PFAS were linked to lower birth size and higher cord TSH, but thyroid hormones did not mediate the link to birth size.

31667854.takeaway: In 198 adults with high bone mass, bone resorption markers were positively related to circulating citrate and inversely to triglycerides, with the citrate link replicated in 3,664 UK perimenopausal women.

31671402.takeaway: Among 713 French patients with primary hyperparathyroidism, 6.6% carried a GCM2 variant, and the authors suggest including GCM2 in genetic screening for the disease.

31673695.takeaway: Narrative review of fibrous dysplasia/McCune-Albright syndrome, a mosaic GNAS activating disease with variable bone lesions and hyperfunctioning endocrinopathies whose presentation depends on age and tissues involved.

31674171.takeaway: Review of metabolic bone disease in preterm infants, reported in 16% to 40% of extremely low birth weight neonates and driven by low calcium and phosphorus stores, drugs and immobility.

31676901.takeaway: Review of long-acting GH preparations, which allow weekly to monthly dosing; several trials reported non-inferiority to daily rhGH for growth velocity in children with GH deficiency.

31677208.takeaway: In 278 obese non-diabetic youth, a late OGTT glucose peak after 30 minutes was linked to impaired beta-cell function, blunted incretin response and lower insulin sensitivity than an early peak.

31677603.takeaway: Among 3,562 pregnant women in Peking, mild TSH elevation with negative TPO antibodies in the first trimester was associated with miscarriage and composite maternal outcomes; levothyroxine benefit remains uncertain.

31678991.takeaway: In 187 pheochromocytoma and paraganglioma tumors, lncRNA profiles defined four subtypes, and one lncRNA discriminated metastatic from benign tumors in SDHx carriers with an AUC of 0.95.

31680140.takeaway: In 23 IGF1R mutation carriers versus 34 SGA children on GH, carriers had a smaller first-year height gain (0.29 vs 0.65 SDS) and three times as many poor responders.

31685489.takeaway: In 93 severely obese adolescents with type 2 diabetes, medical treatment was associated with higher odds of diabetic kidney disease over 5 years than metabolic bariatric surgery.

31688079.takeaway: Multi-institutional anesthesia recommendations for perioperative care of children with type 1 diabetes, covering fasting, insulin dosing and management of hypo- and hyperglycemia, ideally with endocrinologist input.

31689711.takeaway: CHD7 variants were found in 10.2% (18 of 177) of Chinese probands with idiopathic hypogonadotropic hypogonadism, and their phenotypes were analysed in detail.

31689713.takeaway: In 47 young adults with Prader-Willi syndrome, leukocyte telomere length was shorter than in healthy and GH-treated SGA young adults, suggesting accelerated biological aging independent of GH.

31690637.takeaway: In 3,281 pregnant women with GDM, excessive weight gain at presentation was linked to higher fasting glucose on oral glucose tolerance test, more insulin use and large-for-gestational-age births.

31694397.takeaway: A simulation of 100,000 neonatal glucose values showed that meter bias and imprecision misclassify values at Canadian action thresholds, with 3% to 12.5% called hypoglycemic at 5% CV and -10 mg/dL bias.

31694859.takeaway: In 1.8 million Israeli adolescents followed into adulthood, a resolved single childhood episode of acute pancreatitis was associated with later diabetes (OR 2.23), mostly type 2 and at younger ages.

31697435.takeaway: Compared with 414 control families, 105 families with a child who has type 1 diabetes reported lower child quality of life and more maternal distress, with less parental autonomy support.

31697830.takeaway: A genome-wide study of 5,740 people with cystic fibrosis identified CFRD modifiers, including a novel PTMA locus, and showed CFRD shares genetic risk with type 2 diabetes through beta-cell pathways.

31697832.takeaway: In 414 healthy Norwegian boys aged 6 to 16, testicular volume explained more variance in testosterone than chronological age, so hormone references stratified by volume may aid diagnosis.

31698511.takeaway: In 42 patients with Cushing's disease treated with radiotherapy, peri-radiotherapy cabergoline did not change initial remission but was associated with higher recurrence after remission.

31702013.takeaway: In 448 Chinese girls with central precocious or early fast puberty, GnRHa plus rhGH gave more height gain than GnRHa alone or no treatment, with the authors recommending weighing height gains against cost.

31702014.takeaway: Mini-review of genes and pathways controlling pituitary development and how their mutations cause congenital hypopituitarism, which may appear in the neonatal period or later in childhood.

31702838.takeaway: Across four Nordic countries, childhood T1D incidence in 2006 to 2011 averaged 35.7 per 100,000, ranged from 18.2 to 44.1 by country, and generally fell with population density.

31704690.takeaway: In 3,933 Swedish children with diabetes, absent islet autoantibodies and HbA1c below 7.5% at diagnosis identified 78% of MODY cases, so such children should be tested for GCK, HNF1A and HNF4A MODY.

31705682.takeaway: In 601 girls with early breast onset, a basal LH cut-off of 0.2 IU/L kept specificity near 98% and was more sensitive and cheaper than 0.3 IU/L before GnRH testing.

31705791.takeaway: In 160 men from infertile couples, men with metabolic syndrome had 2.1-fold higher seminal adiponectin, and seminal IL-6 correlated with sperm concentration, motility and vitality.

31711229.takeaway: In 58 healthy young men, the Trier Social Stress Test raised renin, plasma and salivary aldosterone, and cortisol versus placebo, with renin peaking first at 1 minute.

31712321.takeaway: In 79 healthy adults, a smaller fall in respiratory quotient during high-fat overfeeding, reflecting impaired metabolic flexibility, predicted greater weight gain at 6 and 12 months.

31715010.takeaway: Meta-analysis found prenatal dexamethasone significantly reduced virilization in girls at risk for CAH, with no significant differences in birth size, cognition, behavior or temperament.

31715059.takeaway: In 44 children with type 1 diabetes using a predictive low glucose suspend system, mean HbA1c fell from 7.61% to 6.88% across age groups, with minimal time below range.

31720731.takeaway: HIF1α signalling was activated in islets from people with type 1 diabetes, PFKFB3 expression rose fivefold in beta cells, and HIF1α attenuated cytokine-induced beta-cell death.

31720734.takeaway: In 592 mother-child pairs, in-utero gestational diabetes exposure was linked to a lipid metabolite pattern in childhood that tracked with greater adiposity and worse metabolic profiles in girls.

31721724.takeaway: In 21 Black African and 23 white European overweight men, insulin sensitivity was similar, but ectopic fat tracked with insulin sensitivity only in white European men.

31722516.takeaway: In 107 adolescents with type 1 diabetes, risk-behavior scores correlated with HbA1c (r=0.36), and girls with poor control showed higher risk scores and more orthorexic eating tendencies.

31722517.takeaway: Of 147 pediatric DKA episodes, most families did not call an ambulance, and EMS transport was linked to more complications, including acute kidney injury and PICU admission.

31723976.takeaway: Pooled waist data from 113,453 children in eight countries yielded age- and sex-specific 90th percentile cutoffs for normal-weight youth, which predicted cardiovascular risk with AUC 0.69 in boys and 0.63 in girls.

31727688.takeaway: In 87 children with obesity, those with insulin resistance showed a urinary steroid signature of high adrenal androgens and glucocorticoids, suggesting insulin resistance may directly stimulate adrenal steroid production.

31728565.takeaway: In TEDDY children at genetic risk, higher childhood plasma ascorbic acid was associated with lower risk of islet autoimmunity (OR 0.96 per mg/L), but not with type 1 diabetes itself.

31730174.takeaway: In 31 adolescent girls with PCOS, circulating miR-451a was low at baseline and normalized after one year of spironolactone-pioglitazone-metformin, but not with oral contraceptives.

31730177.takeaway: In UK primary care records, XLH prevalence rose from 3.1 per million in 1995-1999 to 14.0 per million in 2012-2016, and possible XLH cases had higher mortality than matched controls (HR 2.93).

31735971.takeaway: In 68 patients with Nelson's syndrome from 13 UK centers, 10-year tumor progression-free survival was 62%, and prior management with surgery, radiotherapy and adrenalectomy carried the highest progression risk (HR 4.6).

31738827.takeaway: In 20 critically ill men after cardiac surgery, cortisol secretion exceeded that of 19 healthy men, mainly from nonpulsatile release, so current HPA tests may not diagnose adrenal insufficiency here.

31740441.takeaway: In a prospective high-risk cohort of 67 children, integrated biomarker models predicted islet autoimmunity (AUC 0.91) and progression to diabetes (AUC 0.92) in cross-validation, pending independent validation.

31744271.takeaway: Review of managing paediatric growth disorders on GH therapy, emphasising adherence, digital injection tracking, identifying poor responders and motivational interviewing to improve outcomes.

31744812.takeaway: In 15 adults with type 2 diabetes, larger wholegrain particle size was linked to a smaller postprandial glucose response (P=0.039), and stone-ground bread's response was lower than predicted.

31745564.takeaway: In autopsied adrenal glands from 30 men and 25 women aged 0 to 104, zona fasciculata telomere shortening tracked with adrenal weight loss in older men but not in older women.

31747094.takeaway: Among adolescents with gender dysphoria at one hospital, type 1 diabetes prevalence was 24.77 per 1000, versus 2.68 per 1000 without gender dysphoria, and glycemic control improved after the first gender clinic visit.

31747461.takeaway: Narrative review of how adrenal disorders such as Cushing's, adrenal tumours, premature adrenarche and CAH can accelerate or impair linear growth, and how early diagnosis and treatment limit height loss.

31751300.takeaway: In 388 individuals on guideline-based gender-affirming hormones, transmen reached amenorrhoea in a median of 3 months, with acne most common and venous thromboembolism in 1.9% of transwomen.

31751304.takeaway: Sequential genetic testing of 42 children with tall stature established a diagnosis in 33%, identifying the cause in 43% of syndromic and 8% of non-syndromic patients.

31752481.takeaway: Two children with progeria developed fulminant diabetes at a very early age, illustrating how this accelerated-aging DNA repair disorder can unmask age-related diseases in childhood.

31754749.takeaway: In 80 juvenile-onset type 1 diabetes patients, high T-cell responders to beta-cell antigens did not have worse glycaemic control or complications, and the number of antigens recognized rose with disease duration.

31754750.takeaway: Review of sex differences in energy balance and glucose metabolism, noting women's higher insulin sensitivity and oestrogen's protective actions, which disappear as glucose tolerance deteriorates toward diabetes.

31758170.takeaway: In 250 patients with ACTH-dependent Cushing's syndrome, a revised BIPSS cutoff of 1.4 before and 2.8 after desmopressin raised sensitivity to 94.7% and 97.8% while keeping specificity at 100%.

31760420.takeaway: Across six trials of 2,249 euthyroid women with thyroid autoimmunity, levothyroxine did not improve pregnancy outcomes overall, though individualized dosing reduced miscarriage risk.

31761939.takeaway: In 218 obese boys, testicular volume reached 4 mL at about 11.3 years, earlier than in 660 healthy-weight controls, while other puberty milestones did not differ significantly.

31761940.takeaway: In girls aged 10 to 16, type 1 diabetes was linked to 7% lower trabecular density and 21% higher cortical porosity than controls, most marked when HbA1c exceeded 8.5%.

31765022.takeaway: In 11 transgender men on testosterone, flow-mediated vasodilation was about half that of 20 cisgender women (4.5% vs 8.1%), suggesting testosterone-driven endothelial dysfunction.

31766883.takeaway: In 14 adults with sepsis receiving high-dose IV vitamin C, only 73.9% of paired point-of-care glucose values met ISO accuracy criteria, though clinical impact was likely minimal.

31768570.takeaway: In 1,815 TrialNet participants with multiple autoantibodies, type 1 diabetes risk varied widely with age, autoantibody type and Index60, falling to 8% at five years in a low-risk subgroup.

31769495.takeaway: A 12-year-old boy with growth hormone deficiency, optic nerve hypoplasia and nephrotic-range albuminuria had LAMB2 mutations, linking laminin β2 defects to hypopituitarism and kidney disease.

31770102.takeaway: In 219 people with congenital hypogonadotropic hypogonadism or Kallmann syndrome, adult height exceeded target height and sibling height, and growth during replacement was greater when treatment began earlier.

31770106.takeaway: In 82 children aged 3 to 12, des-acyl ghrelin and LEAP2 were lower in those with overweight or obesity, and des-acyl ghrelin tracked with insulin resistance, suggesting increased ghrelin tone in childhood obesity.

31773787.takeaway: In 143 pituitary adenoma patients, a microcystic pattern on T2-weighted MRI identified silent corticotroph adenomas with 93% specificity and 90% accuracy, though sensitivity was only 58%.

31774122.takeaway: In 1,128 adults in Switzerland, soluble α-klotho related to plasma phosphate in an age-dependent way and to PTH in a sex-dependent way, suggesting it modulates mineral metabolism.

31774125.takeaway: In 203 healthy urban children aged 6 months to 10 years, total and calculated free 25-hydroxyvitamin D correlated strongly (r=0.89), and total levels inversely tracked BMI, with insulin correlations lost after adjustment.

31778168.takeaway: Across 57 neonatal severe hyperparathyroidism cases, CASR homozygotes had higher calcium and PTH than heterozygotes, and calcium above 4.5 mM occurred only in homozygotes.

31778277.takeaway: In 102 children with overweight or obesity, adding exercise to a lifestyle program raised the share responding for hepatic fat (54% vs 34%) and adiposity measures compared with lifestyle alone.

31781766.takeaway: Children of parents with MEN1 had higher postpartum and childhood mortality in the Tasman kindred, with excess risk at 15 years for offspring of MEN1-positive mothers (HR 8.50) and fathers (HR 3.82).

31782289.takeaway: A novel heterozygous GLI2 splice variant was found in a boy with multiple pituitary hormone deficiency and pituitary stalk interruption, and in two siblings and their father with distinct phenotypes.

31782290.takeaway: Children with newly diagnosed Graves' disease had higher soluble CD40 ligand than 48 healthy children, and levels correlated with TSH receptor antibodies and thyroid volume.

31782879.takeaway: In 356 children with new type 1 diabetes in East London, older age at diagnosis (12 to 18 years), higher baseline HbA1c, non-white ethnicity and diagnosis before 2011 predicted poorer glycemic control.

31784715.takeaway: Review arguing that online, youth-oriented approaches can prevent weight gain in young people, whose obesity prevalence in Europe remains under 5%.

31788937.takeaway: In 112 children with type 1 diabetes, the Gold and Clarke questionnaires both had acceptable psychometric properties, classifying 41% and 22% as having impaired hypoglycemia awareness.

31789577.takeaway: In 85 children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes, CGM-adherent participants were younger and some had better organization-of-environment skills, with alarm fatigue the main reason for stopping.

31793003.takeaway: In 30,613 Chinese men, a serum inhibin B cut-off above 77.72 pg/mL predicted successful sperm retrieval with 59% sensitivity and 92% specificity.

31797499.takeaway: Among 1,420 children with type 1 diabetes in the SWEET registry, year-three HbA1c tracked more closely with HbA1c at onset than with DKA at onset, so earlier detection of hyperglycemia may matter.

31797506.takeaway: Among 2,172 youth and young adults with type 1 diabetes, 63% to 93% had each ADA-recommended complication screen, and greater satisfaction with care predicted meeting screening criteria.

31797741.takeaway: Among 1,008 people irradiated for benign childhood conditions, developing thyroid cancer did not affect all-cause survival compared with matched irradiated controls.

31800147.takeaway: In 25 healthy infants of mothers with or without type 1 diabetes, gut virome sampling found distinct virus profiles, with any-virus positivity linked to maternal type 1 diabetes and older infant age.

31800294.takeaway: In a Danish survey of 263 people using pumps or sensors, skin problems added costs that rose with severity, especially for children with sensor-related eczema or wounds.

31801353.takeaway: Review of diabetes technology and mental health, noting that diabetes raises suicidal ideation and self-harm risk, and that technology burden and distress can offset its glycemic benefits.

31802143.takeaway: In 4.2 million Swedish singletons followed to age 43, preterm birth was linked to higher risks of type 1 and type 2 diabetes, with type 2 HR 1.49 in adults aged 18 to 43.

31802590.takeaway: In 121 adolescents with type 2 diabetes versus 34 controls, left ventricular diastolic filling was lower and carotid strain reduced, with raised branched-chain amino acids, but in utero diabetes exposure did not explain them.

31803919.takeaway: Review of oxytocin's metabolic effects, which in models promote weight loss through reduced intake, with human responses varying by nutrient milieu, sex and experimental paradigm.

31804738.takeaway: Review finding youth-onset type 2 diabetes progresses faster than in adults, with yearly beta-cell decline of 20% to 35% versus 7% to 11%.

31804959.takeaway: Review of laboratory testing, dietary management and medical support for women with inborn errors of intermediary metabolism during pregnancy and lactation, including aminoacidopathies, carbohydrate disorders and fatty acid oxidation defects.

31804960.takeaway: In 138 girls with idiopathic central precocious puberty, BMI-SDS rose during GnRH agonist treatment in normal-weight girls but returned to baseline after treatment, while overweight and obese girls did not change.

31804961.takeaway: A 13-year-old girl developed sinusitis eight days after radioactive iodine therapy for Graves' disease, an under-recognized adverse effect that the authors report as a first pediatric case.

31804962.takeaway: Among 275 Saudi children with isolated short stature, 5.8% had biopsy-proven celiac disease, which the authors consider comparable to published reports.

31804963.takeaway: In 354 overweight or obese adolescents, metabolic syndrome prevalence was 9.6%, with obesity and insufficient activity linked to higher odds, and being a girl linked to lower odds.

31804968.takeaway: Monozygotic twins discordant for CAH carried mosaic CYP21A2 cell lines from a postzygotic full gene deletion, which the authors link to their differing phenotypes.

31806625.takeaway: In mice, growth hormone induced β-cell serotonin through STAT5 during the perinatal period, and serotonin acting through HTR2B drove perinatal β-cell proliferation that sets adult β-cell mass.

31808375.takeaway: Among 1,521 pregnant women in Brussels, thyroid autoimmunity and subclinical hypothyroidism were tested against six poor pregnancy outcomes after adjustment for demographic and obstetric factors.

31808586.takeaway: Qualitative interviews with parents of 79 children aged 1 to under 8 with type 1 diabetes identified emotional burden, difficulty finding trusted secondary caregivers and a need for more personalized education.

31809263.takeaway: In 44 girls with central precocious puberty on GnRH analogues, IGF-1 did not change significantly after 12 months, and growth velocity was not correlated with IGF-1.

31809264.takeaway: In 80 children with obesity, LDL cholesterol varied by BMI group and free fatty acids by tri-ponderal mass index, while inflammatory markers did not track with TMI, and only fetuin-A correlated with BMI.

31809265.takeaway: In 699 youth with recent-onset type 2 diabetes, adding oral medications did not change study-medication adherence, which was lower in those on insulin.

31809266.takeaway: Five Turkish patients from two families with citrin deficiency, including two with neonatal cholestasis and three with adult-onset citrullinemia, carried a novel homozygous SLC25A13 mutation.

31811804.takeaway: In 32 children with optic nerve hypoplasia, 75% developed pituitary hormone deficiencies, 56% by 12 months of age, with ADH, TSH and ACTH deficiencies diagnosed earliest.

31811805.takeaway: In 105 patients with Turner syndrome on GH, younger age at treatment start was the strongest predictor of first-year height gain, and mid-parental height with first-year gain predicted height after three years.

31811806.takeaway: In 42 mothers of children with phenylketonuria, a year of weekly psychological support eased social discrimination and quality-of-life damage, with the greatest benefit among university-educated mothers.

31812946.takeaway: In 48 obese adolescent girls with prehypertension, 12 weeks of jump rope training significantly reduced body fat, blood pressure and insulin resistance compared with controls.

31812947.takeaway: Among 65 pump visits in 53 youth, 45 had air bubbles in the tubing and 7.7% had more than 60 minutes without insulin; bubbles were larger in older patients.

31813006.takeaway: Commentary on a population study in which autoimmunity predicted adult-onset non-insulin-requiring diabetes, though it had only a limited effect on overall adult diabetes risk.

31813323.takeaway: In a province-wide database of 959 patients with papillary thyroid cancer, intraoperative risk factors required conversion for 21% of lobectomy-eligible patients, and 30% still needed completion thyroidectomy.

31820534.takeaway: Meta-regression of 68 pediatric obesity lifestyle studies found larger BMI-SDS losses went with greater falls in HOMA-IR and CRP, though no minimum BMI change reliably ensured metabolic improvement.

31820549.takeaway: In 1.48 million US infants followed in an insurer database, congenital rubella was associated with 12-fold higher odds of childhood diabetes and congenital cytomegalovirus with 4-fold higher odds.

31820785.takeaway: Two novel heterozygous Gα11 variants, p.Gly66Ser and p.Arg149His, were found in two autosomal dominant hypocalcemia type 2 families and increased calcium-sensing signaling in cells in a dose-dependent manner.

31821166.takeaway: Screening of 1,006,404 neonates in Isfahan found congenital hypothyroidism at 2.3 per 1000 births, with incidence linked to city, climate, precipitation and sunlight.

31821167.takeaway: A 9-month-old girl with growth retardation, microcephaly and seizures had primary coenzyme Q10 deficiency from a novel homozygous COQ9 frameshift, treated with exogenous CoQ10 from 10 months.

31821448.takeaway: In a kindred with five patients with autosomal dominant hypophosphatemic rickets, a novel SGK3 variant segregated with disease and caused in-frame exon 13 skipping, implicating SGK3 in renal phosphate transport.

31821453.takeaway: Serum sclerostin was increased in 30 adults with active acromegaly compared with 30 healthy volunteers.

31821467.takeaway: In 152 young women aged 16 to 27, anorexia nervosa lowered hip bone density relative to controls from age 21, while obesity raised hip density from age 19, and both conditions lowered bone formation markers.

31821578.takeaway: Among 350 people with gender dysphoria at a German endocrine clinic, transmen became more numerous after 2013, and graduation rates were about half and unemployment twice the general population's.

31822488.takeaway: Of 550 youth and young adults with type 1 diabetes screened, 9% endorsed suicidal ideation, most with elevated depressive symptoms; none had current plans, though five noted insulin's lethality.

31825119.takeaway: In 57 children with type 1 diabetes, 57% had abnormal 24-hour blood pressure versus 24% of controls (OR 6.7), and higher BMI tracked with carotid thickness only in those with abnormal pressure.

31825128.takeaway: Among 36 probands referred for HNF1B testing in a Polish registry, cystic kidneys, pancreatic abnormalities and elevated liver enzymes best distinguished HNF1B-positive cases.

31825129.takeaway: In 459 adolescents and young adults, global longitudinal strain fell from lean to obese to type 2 diabetes, and obesity and diabetes both impaired systolic function, with BMI explaining much of diabetes' effect.

31825248.takeaway: In a randomized clamp study of 29 adult men with type 1 diabetes, a biosimilar insulin aspart matched US and EU insulin aspart on pharmacokinetic and glucodynamic measures.

31825485.takeaway: Adolescents with obesity had fasting and postprandial dyslipidemia, particularly larger triglyceride-rich lipoprotein excursions, with reduced postprandial GLP-1 and GLP-2 responses to a fat load.

31826866.takeaway: IGF1 and IGF2 were lower in autoantibody-positive relatives than in negative relatives, and IGF1 fell over time in those with multiple autoantibodies and those who progressed to type 1 diabetes.

31830859.takeaway: In 4,045 papillary thyroid cancer patients, only extension beyond the strap muscles predicted worse overall survival, while strap-muscle (T3b) extension did not independently predict worse outcomes.

31832635.takeaway: In 45 pregnant women, visceral adipose thickness measured in early pregnancy was the only anthropometric measure independently associated with birth weight centile, explaining about 16% of its variance.

31832744.takeaway: In 84 women with well-controlled gestational diabetes, most serum fatty acids were lower than in 90 controls, with arachidonic and docosahexaenoic acids unchanged in mothers.

31833547.takeaway: In lean African American women, altered skeletal muscle mitochondrial pathways tracked with lower insulin sensitivity, resting metabolic rate and aerobic fitness.

31834861.takeaway: In 36 adolescents with gender dysphoria on triptorelin, transgirls lost height and lean mass SDS over 12 months, while transboys' body composition did not change significantly.

31834862.takeaway: Among 224 obese Mexican children, metabolically healthy obesity prevalence was 12.9% by absence of metabolic syndrome but 56.3% by one insulin-resistance definition, so the definition strongly changes results.

31834863.takeaway: In 61 Indian children with idiopathic short stature, 6.5% had pathogenic SHOX variants, none had GHR variants, and two of 39 sequenced had novel likely pathogenic IGFALS variants.

31836690.takeaway: Lipid droplets were scarce in juvenile human islets, rose through adulthood, and were enriched in islet alpha and beta cells from donors with type 2 diabetes, while rodent islets accumulated few.

31837064.takeaway: In 92 youth starting hybrid closed loop, HbA1c fell from 8.7% to 8.4% over six months and sensor time in range rose, though 30% discontinued and psychosocial scores did not change.

31838502.takeaway: In 8,413 pregnant women in Boston, TSH above 4 mIU/L was linked to higher risks of prematurity (RR 2.17) and neonatal respiratory distress syndrome (RR 2.83).

31840266.takeaway: In 420 patients in Southern Thailand, a clinical scoring system for primary aldosteronism reached AUC 0.87, and scores below 4 gave 97% sensitivity and 99% negative predictive value.

31840392.takeaway: In 99 children with recent-onset type 1 diabetes, osteocalcin and P1NP Z-scores stayed low and CTX high versus reference, with no change over 12 months or by partial remission status.

31841439.takeaway: Among 16 selected probands with idiopathic short stature, 37.5% carried pathogenic ACAN variants, including a novel intragenic deletion, and these variants mostly co-segregated with short stature in families.

31841602.takeaway: In Mexicans, the MC4R p.Ile269Asn variant was associated with childhood (OR 3.06) and adult obesity (OR 2.58), and co-segregated with obesity in five multigenerational pedigrees.

31842523.takeaway: Of 211 children tested with intramuscular short ACTH, 78% had normal peak cortisol and 8.5% an inadequate response, and 15 of those 18 later needed cortisol therapy.

31842524.takeaway: Proposal that the IGF-I SDS cut-off for GH stimulation testing should vary from 0 to -2 SDS depending on the clinical pre-test likelihood of growth hormone deficiency.

31843946.takeaway: In a 1,985-case type 1 diabetes genetic study, HLA-B*39 effects were confirmed, but independent MHC class I effects were not seen in latent autoimmune diabetes of adults.

31843949.takeaway: In a Quebec cohort, adolescents and emerging adults with diabetes had higher risks of mood disorders (HR 1.33), suicide attempts (HR 3.25) and psychiatric care use than peers without diabetes through age 25.

31843955.takeaway: In 50 donors without diabetes, longer ICU stays from six days onward were linked to three- to sixfold more M2 macrophages, higher vascular density and more replicating pancreatic cells.

31845345.takeaway: Of 147 Australian endocrinologists and trainees surveyed, only 19% felt confident starting gender-affirming hormone therapy, and 96% reported no transgender medicine training at medical school.

31845423.takeaway: In 2,258 children aged 6 to 18, those with overweight or obesity had higher leptin, lower adiponectin and a higher leptin-to-adiponectin ratio than normal-weight peers.

31845996.takeaway: In 1,332 healthy children aged 5 to 19, adiposity changed 13 routine biochemical markers, including ALT, apolipoprotein B and CRP.

31846425.takeaway: In 112 children with obesity, neck circumference was larger in those with NAFLD and independently associated with it (OR 1.17), with cut-offs of 35 cm for Tanner 2-3 and 38 cm for Tanner 4-5.

31846426.takeaway: A survey of 53 European centres found that 44% of those treating vitamin B12-responsive methylmalonic acidaemia prescribed protein below WHO safe levels for at least one age group.

31846427.takeaway: Among 137 children with type 1 diabetes, 54% reported at least one gastrointestinal complaint, most often reflux (32.8%) and abdominal symptoms.

31851614.takeaway: Among 1,944 Egyptian children aged 8 to 16, girls with BMI at or above the 85th percentile reached all pubertal stages earlier than girls with average BMI.

31851615.takeaway: Among 220,000 newborns screened, five had MAT I/III deficiency causing hypermethioninemia, which the authors say needs long-term follow-up except for benign mutations.

31851616.takeaway: A systematic review of 16 studies found heterogeneous associations between prenatal organochlorine pesticide exposure and neonatal thyroid function tests.

31853550.takeaway: GDF15 was higher in Addison's disease patients than in healthy controls after steroid withdrawal (739 vs 498 pg/mL), and intravenous hydrocortisone reduced it across replacement cohorts.

31854476.takeaway: In a survey of paediatric diabetes teams in England and Wales, 76% knew periodontitis is a diabetes complication, but only 5% screened for it and 92% had no periodontal service access.

31854481.takeaway: When parents took over booking clinic appointments for 139 children with type 1 diabetes, HbA1c rose from 59.9 to 63.1 mmol/mol and consultations fell.

31854483.takeaway: Among 84 Pediatric Endocrine Society members surveyed, 85.5% saw exercise counseling as a priority, yet most could not correctly name ODPHP (87.8%) or ADA (79.3%) exercise guidelines.

31854491.takeaway: In 575 young adults in Thailand, the 33 born preterm had 32% higher fasting insulin and 31% higher HOMA-IR than term-born peers after adjustment.

31855297.takeaway: In 443 six- to eight-year-olds, a cardiometabolic risk score and insulin were linked to lower heart rate variability and a higher LF/HF ratio.

31855446.takeaway: In 58 children and adults starting the MiniMed 670G system, HbA1c fell from 7.4% to 7.0% and time in range rose from 63% to 73% over three months.

31856685.takeaway: Two children with mild neurological features and normal thyroid tests carried MCT8 variants of unknown significance, and a new functional assay showed the de novo R388Q variant transported thyroid hormone normally.

31858184.takeaway: In 11,192 Australian women followed for up to 19 years, 162 developed type 2 diabetes, and higher initial BMI in early adulthood was positively associated with risk.

31859529.takeaway: Describes the Pediatric Diabetes Consortium model, a centralized coordinating structure for phase 3 trials of new drugs in youth with type 2 diabetes, credited with helping complete a pivotal liraglutide trial.

31860471.takeaway: Review finds limited evidence that growth hormone given to short children born SGA modestly improves metabolic and cardiovascular risk, with weaker support for bone and psychosocial benefits.

31862756.takeaway: ADA Standards of Care chapter on children and adolescents with diabetes, setting out current clinical practice recommendations, treatment goals and quality-of-care tools, updated annually.

31863141.takeaway: Among 197,796 Welsh births, teenagers with childhood-onset type 1 diabetes had lower pregnancy rates than teenagers without diabetes (8.6 vs 18.0 per 1,000 girls).

31863541.takeaway: Focus groups with 46 adolescents and 39 parents identified three themes shaping acceptability of financial incentives for diabetes self-care: family values, perceived effectiveness and the urgency of preventing complications.

31863690.takeaway: In 876 youth with overweight or obesity, high cortisol and high IGF-I quartiles were linked to hypertension and dyslipidemia, while low IGF-I with rising cortisol linked to higher glucose and insulin resistance.

31865369.takeaway: In 100 untreated hyperthyroid Graves' patients, undiluted serum TSAb distinguished Graves' disease with orbitopathy, and diluted TSAb titres separated methimazole responders from nonresponders.

31865390.takeaway: Review of how osteoporosis is defined and diagnosed in children, covering the 2013 ISCD revised criteria, genetic bone fragility and bone densitometry.

31867598.takeaway: Sequencing 26 Sudanese families with congenital hypothyroidism found variants in DUOX1/2, IYD, SLC26A4, SLC26A7, SLC5A5, TG and TPO, with TG mutations more frequent than in other populations.

31867614.takeaway: Among 786 TrialNet relatives who developed type 1 diabetes, 15% had only a single autoantibody at diagnosis, and these people were older and had higher C-peptide and insulin resistance.

31868128.takeaway: Two siblings in a consanguineous Sudanese family with congenital hypothyroidism and goitre carried a novel Alu element insertion in the thyroglobulin gene, a new cause of the disorder.

31872219.takeaway: In an ancillary analysis of 881 women in a vitamin D trial, a CLIA assay overestimated cord-blood 25(OH)D compared with LC-MS/MS, so neonatal vitamin D status may be overstated.

31875411.takeaway: In 12 parent interviews, families using the MiaoMiao do-it-yourself CGM reported fewer perceived hypoglycemia episodes and better sleep, but faced setup and connectivity challenges and limited team support.

31875910.takeaway: In 1,058 Caucasian patients with differentiated thyroid cancer, BMI category was not associated with histologic aggressiveness, recurrence risk or treatment response after a median 5.7 years.

31875913.takeaway: In 29 young patients with Cushing syndrome versus 8 controls, brain MRI changes in gray and white matter tracked cortisol levels and whether the syndrome persisted or resolved.

31876026.takeaway: In 24 children with pituitary adenomas, 38% had obesity at diagnosis, including all five with Cushing's disease, and obesity may persist after successful treatment.

31882410.takeaway: In 718 older adults with type 1 diabetes (mean age 67), recent severe hypoglycemia was linked to lower global cognition and lower language, executive function and episodic memory scores.

31882561.takeaway: Trio genome sequencing of 44 patients with permanent neonatal diabetes, with replication in 188 others, identified de novo EIF2B1 missense variants as a novel cause of permanent diabetes with hepatic dysfunction.

31882564.takeaway: In 430 mother-offspring pairs, 188 placental DNA methylation sites tracked maternal insulin sensitivity in pregnancy, including imprinted loci such as H19/MIR675.

31883394.takeaway: A young boy with severe short stature had a novel heterozygous GHR nonsense mutation in the transmembrane domain, causing GH insensitivity with elevated GH and GH binding protein levels.

31885113.takeaway: In 5,546 Indian patients diagnosed by age 25 in a clinic registry, T1D (63.9%) and T2D (25.3%) were the commonest types, with T1D diagnosed at a mean age of 12.9 years.

31885114.takeaway: In 85 adolescents with type 1 diabetes, a computerized simulation program lowered 3-month HbA1c versus controls (8.7% vs 9.6%), with mechanistic understanding and self-management knowledge explaining part of the change.

31885120.takeaway: A coping skills program did not significantly change outcomes over 12 months in 100 Chinese youth with type 1 diabetes, though school-aged children benefited more than adolescents.

31885123.takeaway: In 92 youth starting the 670G hybrid closed loop, 30% discontinued within six months, and each 1% higher baseline HbA1c raised the odds of stopping 2.7-fold, with calibration difficulty and alarms cited.

31885187.takeaway: In 600 Chilean adolescents followed since infancy, higher BMI z-score at age 10 raised metabolic risk at 16 directly and via adiponectin-to-leptin ratio and insulin resistance, while ghrelin was not on that pathway.

31886730.takeaway: A US lifetime simulation of people with type 1 diabetes estimated their cumulative medical and lost-productivity costs against a matched cohort without the disease.

31886890.takeaway: In 244 adults with CAH, simple-virilizing women had lower bone density than salt-wasting women, and prednisolone rather than hydrocortisone-only therapy gave worse trochanter Z-scores.

31886931.takeaway: In adolescents with type 2 diabetes in TODAY, 50% of males and 29% of females in the lifestyle arm improved health-behaviour profiles at 6 months.

31893581.takeaway: Across 108,742 vitamin D measurements in Turkey, mean 25-OHD was highest in infants and lowest in adults over 18 (about 18 to 22 ng/mL), with the lowest deficiency rate at ages 1 to 3.

31896551.takeaway: Offspring of mothers with type 1 diabetes had reduced cord-blood CD4+ T-cell responses to proinsulin and a reduced inflammatory profile at 9 months, suggesting improved neonatal tolerance to proinsulin.

31896601.takeaway: In 7,522 genetically high-risk TEDDY children, faster infant weight gain raised islet autoimmunity risk (HR 1.09 per kg/year), as did faster height gain in early childhood (HR 1.48 per cm/year).

31897525.takeaway: Review of changing paediatric diabetes, noting rising incidence, growing difficulty in separating type 1 from type 2 in obese youth, and emerging treatments aimed at glycaemic control.

31898446.takeaway: A 12-year-old girl with Cushing syndrome had an ectopic ACTH-secreting bronchial carcinoid, which was resected surgically, and she recovered after multidisciplinary management.

31901092.takeaway: In adolescents with PCOS and obesity, those with metabolic syndrome had more sleep-disordered breathing, and more poor sleep health behaviours went with more metabolic syndrome components.

31901217.takeaway: In the HOME birth cohort, each doubling of maternal TSH raised newborn TSH by 16.4%, and each doubling of newborn TSH raised TSH at age three by 10.4%.

31903484.takeaway: In 205 patients with pheochromocytoma or paraganglioma, BAT activation on FDG-PET/CT was associated with decreased overall survival, based on 16 patients with BAT activation compared with 36 matched controls.

31904260.takeaway: Describes a proof-of-concept that integrated CGM data directly into a pediatric hospital's electronic health record through a manufacturer partnership, using HL7 standards and real-time data acquisition.

31905008.takeaway: In 21,253 T1D Exchange registry participants, any device use (pump or CGM) was linked to lower HbA1c at every age, with lower socioeconomic status and African American race linked to higher HbA1c across ages.

31905439.takeaway: Review of skeletal mineralisation, covering matrix vesicles, calcium and phosphate supply, and how vitamin D deficiency, chronic hypophosphatemia and excess FGF23 action cause rickets and osteomalacia.

31905440.takeaway: Review of perirenal and epicardial fat in children, visceral depots easily measured by ultrasound and linked to carotid intima-media thickness, a marker of subclinical atherosclerosis.

31905441.takeaway: Birth-length references built from 843 Korean newborns in a national survey gave an SGA cut-off of 48 cm below the 10th percentile for both sexes, differing from other ethnic references.

31905442.takeaway: In 23 patients with ovotesticular DSD or mixed gonadal dysgenesis, all presented with ambiguous genitalia in infancy, and most in both groups were raised as males.

31905443.takeaway: Of 12 infants screen-positive for low T4/TSH in Alabama, four (30%) had permanent congenital hypothyroidism, and one moderately severe central case was detected only by the routine second newborn screen.

31905444.takeaway: In 38 boys with NAFLD, 87% fell in the high BMI and body fat zone of a body composition chart and 11% in the sarcopenic obesity zone.

31905445.takeaway: A 10-year-old Korean girl with autoimmune polyendocrine syndrome type 1 had adrenal insufficiency and chronic candidiasis from a compound heterozygous AIRE variant, including a newly found frameshift.

31905446.takeaway: The first Korean family with Tatton-Brown-Rahman syndrome showed maternal inheritance of a novel DNMT3A variant, with tall stature, macrocephaly and intellectual disability in mother and daughter.

31905447.takeaway: Two Korean adolescents with ketosis-prone diabetes, one first seen in ketoacidosis and later managed on metformin, showed how diabetes can fail to fit the type 1 or type 2 categories.

31905448.takeaway: Two children with heterozygous GCK variants (MODY-2) were found during workup of mild asymptomatic hyperglycaemia with negative β-cell antibodies, supporting MODY-2 as a consideration in such cases.

31910104.takeaway: A five-year-old girl with tall stature and nonautoimmune hyperthyroidism had a somatic mosaic GNAS mutation in three of four thyroid quadrants, and a molecular diagnosis may avoid unnecessary total thyroid ablation.

31910105.takeaway: In 153 children with differentiated thyroid cancer treated from 1979 to 2014, 22% had recurrence, and risk factors for disease-free survival were used to stratify risk.

31910118.takeaway: A 10-gene thyroid genetic classifier correctly predicted benign nodules among indeterminate cytology in two independent prospective multicentre validation trials.

31910129.takeaway: In 65 patients with retropharyngeal node metastases from thyroid cancer, 80% of observed nodes stayed under 1.5 cm, and management ranged from observation to nonsurgical treatment or resection.

31912137.takeaway: In 70 patients with Carney complex followed prospectively for three years, new manifestations included subclinical acromegaly in 6 and cardiac myxomas in 2, with myxoma recurrence in 4.

31912198.takeaway: In TRIGR children at genetic risk, serum 25OHD was lower 18 months before islet autoimmunity in cases than in matched controls (57.7 vs 64.8 nmol/L), and it was also lower before type 1 diabetes.

31912872.takeaway: In 23,138 rural Chinese adults, later menarche (18 years or older) was linked to 17.7% lower type 2 diabetes risk, an association attenuated by BMI, and menopause status modified glucose responses to menarche age.

31914441.takeaway: A consanguineous Sudanese proband with low-TSH congenital hypothyroidism was homozygous for a novel TSHβ C47W variant, with both parents heterozygous, identifying a cause of central congenital hypothyroidism.

31914447.takeaway: Review of how microRNAs regulate growth plate function and the GH-IGF-1 axis, summarizing evidence from in vitro and animal studies across species.

31914726.takeaway: A nine-month-old girl with abetalipoproteinemia from a novel homozygous MTTP variant also had central hypothyroidism, a combination not previously reported.

31915205.takeaway: In the 307-child EarlyBird cohort followed for 12 years, several diabetes-risk gene variants shaped childhood insulin secretion and fasting glucose trajectories, some interacting with age and the GH-IGF-1 axis.

31915828.takeaway: In 401 Chilean boys, a polygenic score for voice break was associated with age at gonadarche and pubarche, suggesting shared genetic architecture of pubertal timing.

31915893.takeaway: In 645 Australian newborns across glucose tolerance states, higher cord C-peptide was linked to larger birthweight, and cord metabolic markers strongly mediated maternal adiposity's effect on fetal growth.

31917679.takeaway: Patients with acromegaly had more retinal vessel branching points than 13 healthy controls (median 34.3 vs 27.0), and vessel morphology did not change significantly after treatment.

31917682.takeaway: Three brothers with partial P450scc deficiency had compound heterozygous CYP11A1 variants found by sequencing and were stable on hydrocortisone and fludrocortisone.

31917831.takeaway: In 124,852 people with electronic health records, a combined polygenic and phenotypic score improved PCOS detection across ancestries, and PCOS shared biology with obesity and type 2 diabetes.

31917835.takeaway: In 58 treatment-naive prepubertal children with GH deficiency, once-weekly somapacitan gave annualized height velocities of 8.0 to 12.9 cm/year at week 26, by dose.

31917867.takeaway: Review of managing congenital hyperinsulinism, where few medications with narrow therapeutic windows exist, so individualized plans aim for prompt treatment of hypoglycaemia to protect neurodevelopment.

31918426.takeaway: Across 43 studies, spontaneous thelarche occurred in 32% and spontaneous menarche in 21% of girls with Turner syndrome, with the lowest rates in girls with 45,X monosomy.

31919513.takeaway: In 95 patients with MEN1, 36% were H pylori seropositive, and seropositivity was linked to higher hypergastrinaemia risk (RR 1.72) and to severe hypergastrinaemia.

31920956.takeaway: Review of the mechanisms that trigger puberty, centred on hypothalamic GnRH pulse generation regulated by the kisspeptin-neurokinin-dynorphin (KNDy) system.

31920957.takeaway: In 13 boys with Silver-Russell syndrome, poorer adult height correlated with higher childhood DHEAS, testosterone and DHT, while higher AMH at age 12 correlated with better height.

31920960.takeaway: Systematic review linking AIP and MEN1 mutations to young age at pituitary adenoma diagnosis, recommending mutation testing in patients aged 30 or younger and Xq26.3 screening in children.

31920976.takeaway: Review of metabolically healthy obesity in youth, noting prevalence ranging from 3% to 87% depending on definition and the 2018 consensus definition for children.

31920978.takeaway: Review of childhood Hashimoto thyroiditis and dyslipidaemia, noting that lipid abnormalities worsen as hypothyroidism advances, from discrete changes in euthyroid disease to atherogenic dyslipidaemia.

31922575.takeaway: In 3,415 Australian adolescents followed at ages 12, 14 and 16, free T4 rose in both sexes and TSH increased from age 14 to 16.

31926093.takeaway: In a patient with hereditary vitamin D-resistant rickets, cinacalcet was effective and safe as adjunctive therapy, with the authors suggesting it for VDR-mutant cases refractory to conventional treatment.

31926094.takeaway: In 60 obese children and 31 matched controls, fasting ghrelin, obestatin and their ratio were all lower in obesity, and children with obesity had higher energy and macronutrient intake.

31926095.takeaway: Among 33 obese and overweight Malaysian children, 64% had NAFLD on ultrasound, and those with NAFLD had higher BMI, waist, triglycerides and ALT, with 62% of them meeting IDF metabolic syndrome criteria.

31926096.takeaway: An 11-year-old boy with newly diagnosed type 1 diabetes developed cerebral edema during severe ketoacidosis after diagnostic and treatment delays.

31926097.takeaway: In 148 girls aged 5 to 8 (63 with precocious puberty), those with precocious puberty had larger olfactory bulb volume and pituitary height but smaller eyeball volume, with cut-offs derived for each.

31927520.takeaway: In 1,079 children and adolescents, metabolic syndrome occurred only in those with obesity, more often in pubertal than post-pubertal youth, with no gender difference in prevalence.

31927521.takeaway: Retrospective review of 14 Turkish patients with alkaptonuria, with HGD gene mutation analysis, documenting their clinical course.

31927522.takeaway: In a Chinese family, three members with X-linked hypophosphatemic rickets all carried a PHEX mutation, and the 40-year-old proband also had an NPR2 missense variant.

31927523.takeaway: Among 50 children with severe early-onset obesity in Germany and Poland, none had leptin deficiency or biologically inactive leptin.

31927590.takeaway: In 32 children with CAH identified by neonatal screening, general intellectual ability and executive function matched population controls.

31928168.takeaway: In 65 women with differentiated thyroid cancer, AMH fell 55% over 12 months after a single RAI dose and 85% after 48 months with multiple doses; declines were smaller under age 35.

31932458.takeaway: In the Norwegian KATP neonatal diabetes population, the p.V59M KCNJ11 genotype was strongly linked to substantial intellectual disability, unrelated to when sulfonylurea treatment began.

31934878.takeaway: Salivary cortisol patterns over the day were similar in 17 overweight or obese and 16 normal-weight infants aged 6 to 24 months, though the overweight group showed reduced cortisol at the last sample.

31937608.takeaway: In a 3-month randomized trial of 127 people with type 1 diabetes aged 14 and older, mobile closed-loop control reduced time below 3.9 mmol/L versus sensor-augmented pump therapy (2.4% vs 4.0%) without losing glycemic control.

31937610.takeaway: In 706 TrialNet children with one autoantibody, excess BMI accelerated progression to multiple autoantibodies in those aged 9 and older, though the overall association was not significant.

31943577.takeaway: In 12,652 young Swedes with type 1 diabetes, 68 died, mortality was 2.7-fold the population rate, and those who died from diabetes had higher childhood HbA1c (8.9% vs 7.8%).

31943582.takeaway: In 314 children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes on intensive insulin, tissue factor pathway inhibitor was higher than in 120 controls and correlated with HbA1c, while other coagulation markers did not differ.

31943641.takeaway: Across 7,701 youth in US SEARCH and Indian YDR registries, DKA at diagnosis affected 35.3% of US and 28.7% of Indian youth with type 1 diabetes, and 5.5% to 6.6% with type 2 diabetes.

31948187.takeaway: Among 57 Turkish patients with combined pituitary hormone deficiency, all had GH deficiency and 98% had central hypothyroidism, and eight index patients carried PROP1 mutations.

31948188.takeaway: Among 1,594 Antalya school children, goitre fell from 34% to 0.3% over 16 years of iodization, yet 19% remained iodine deficient and 11.5% had excess intake.

31948189.takeaway: Age-specific internipple index reference curves were built from 667 healthy prepubertal Turkish girls aged 6 to 11, with the index falling as age rose.
