31948275.takeaway: In an online survey of 132 people using FreeStyle Libre, additional readers that convert it to CGM were linked to self-reported lower HbA1c and fewer hypoglycaemic episodes, with better quality of life.

31950145.takeaway: In 31 Turkish children with classical 3β-HSD2 deficiency, 11 homozygous HSD3B2 mutations were found, and variants retaining over 5% enzyme activity went with a non-salt-losing phenotype.

31950148.takeaway: In 27 youth with classic CAH versus 35 controls, MRI showed smaller intracranial and frontal cortex volumes, with medial temporal lobe differences as well.

31951305.takeaway: In normal-weight adolescents, a high-intensity interval exercise session transiently lowered heart rate variability in both those with and without type 1 diabetes, and the T1D group had lower HRV at baseline.

31951309.takeaway: In children under 15 in Elazig, Turkey, T1D incidence averaged 16.7 per 100,000 per year from 2009 to 2019, rising 7.8% a year, and was higher in urban residents.

31953884.takeaway: In 9,650 youth with type 1 and 2,406 with type 2 diabetes across US SEARCH and Indian YDR registries, US youth were diagnosed at younger ages for both types (T1D 10.0 vs 10.5 years).

31953997.takeaway: In 124 children with obesity and 42 controls, serum adropin was lower and leptin and LBP higher in obesity, with adropin negatively correlated with triglycerides, waist-to-hip ratio and BMI.

31954081.takeaway: Among 914 women with PCOS, 40.6% had abnormal glucose metabolism, and aldosterone remained significantly associated with it after adjusting for age, BMI and fasting insulin.

31957151.takeaway: Exome sequencing of 42 Chinese children with suspected MODY identified mutations in 24, mostly in GCK, with four novel GCK variants reported.

31961798.takeaway: In 838 children aged 3 to 18, PAPP-A2 fell throughout childhood while free IGF-I rose, with a pubertal peak in girls, and PAPP-A2 correlated positively with percent free IGF-I.

31961799.takeaway: Pooled individual data from six studies of 30 children with congenital central hypothyroidism gave a mean full-scale IQ of 97, though 27% scored below 85 and 10% below 70.

31961800.takeaway: In 43 children with Prader-Willi syndrome, eight years of growth hormone did not significantly change IQ or subtest scores, with total IQ rising from 66 to 69.

31964278.takeaway: In 118 children and adolescents with differentiated thyroid cancer, pre-ablation stimulated thyroglobulin at or below 17.8 ng/mL predicted disease-free status with a 96.8% negative predictive value.

31970418.takeaway: In 58 obese female adolescents, those with PCOS had lower gut microbial diversity and different relative abundances of several bacterial groups than those without PCOS.

31970420.takeaway: A child with a sclerosing bone dysplasia and adrenocortical adenoma carried a de novo CTNNB1 p.Pro44Leu variant, which increased β-catenin WNT signalling in laboratory assays.

31970828.takeaway: Modelling youth-onset type 1 diabetes in six countries, intermediate care gave much lower 30-year complication rates than minimal care; renal failure reached 68.1% under minimal care.

31970841.takeaway: In 173 children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes, osteocalcin, P1NP and CTX Z-scores were all lower than the reference population, and bone mineral density was comparable to reference.

31971451.takeaway: Among 471 US parents of youth with type 1 diabetes, cluster analysis identified five attitude profiles toward devices, with Embracers the largest group (50.7%), and profiles differed by distress and hypoglycaemia worry.

31971833.takeaway: In a survey of 1,501 US parents, most chose at least one active treatment to delay insulin dependence, and parents of children without T1D valued delaying insulin dependence and reducing complications most.

31972003.takeaway: In 630 obese youths, a delayed OGTT glucose peak after 30 minutes was linked to lower static beta-cell function and more TCF7L2 rs7903146 risk alleles, and a lower disposition index correlated with higher glucose.

31972544.takeaway: Review of inherited primary adrenal insufficiency in children, which can affect gonads, brain, heart, bone, growth, bone marrow, kidney, skin, parathyroid and thyroid beyond the adrenal glands.

31972562.takeaway: Nine of 232 children with central precocious puberty (3.8%) had systemic hypersensitivity to GnRH analogues, and management included switching preparation in six, with no new reactions after that.

31974099.takeaway: In adults with type 1 diabetes in a randomized crossover trial, adding pramlintide to a rapid-insulin artificial pancreas raised time in range from 74% to 84%, with the regular-insulin version showing no change.

31974100.takeaway: Among 5,558 adults with type 1 diabetes in Scotland, symptomatic neuropathy affected 13%, with odds rising with poor glycaemic control, smoking and worse kidney function, and with living in more deprived areas.

31974101.takeaway: In pregnancies with diabetes undergoing early-term scheduled caesarean, antenatal corticosteroids were linked to more neonatal hypoglycaemia (24.2% vs 4.4%), and the authors concluded they were not beneficial.

31974104.takeaway: Among 5,256 campers with type 1 diabetes at 48 American Diabetes Association camps, racial and ethnic minority youth were underrepresented relative to national prevalence.

31974550.takeaway: In Taiwanese adults with diabetes, chronic pancreatitis was linked to 9.5-fold higher DKA risk, 5.0-fold higher HHS and 3.0-fold higher hypoglycaemia than matched patients without it.

31976519.takeaway: In 42 healthy men randomized to oral 11β-MNTDC at 200 or 400 mg daily for 28 days, there were no serious adverse events, and gonadotropins and testosterone were markedly suppressed.

31980846.takeaway: In an ecological analysis of 13,948 children under 10 with type 1 diabetes in England, incidence was 21.2 per 100,000 and the environment-wide scan generated hypotheses about environmental triggers.

31989990.takeaway: Three families had heterozygous INSR missense variants causing neonatal hyperinsulinaemic hypoglycaemia that responded to diazoxide, a presentation not previously described in the neonatal period.

31990163.takeaway: Of 226 infants referred from neonatal screening, 17.7% had dysgenetic thyroid glands, which had significantly higher TSH than eutopic glands.

31990164.takeaway: In 559 children with new type 1 diabetes in Lesser Poland, incidence ranged from 11.2 per 100,000 in 2006 to 21.9 in 2012, while age and BMI-SDS at onset did not change.

31990165.takeaway: In a pilot case-control study, children with Hashimoto thyroiditis had higher serum zonulin, a marker of intestinal permeability, than children with congenital hypothyroidism (59.1 vs 43.3 ng/mL).

31990356.takeaway: Among 87 children with familial short stature treated with GH, 5.7% carried a (likely) pathogenic NPR2 variant, and these carriers responded well to GH therapy.

31993019.takeaway: Argues that an extra 4 to 6 year pre-adult period of emerging adulthood should be included in models of human maturation, as a foundation of human reproductive success.

31995184.takeaway: In 9,749 Korean youths aged 10 to 20, tri-ponderal mass index reference percentiles were built, and BMI was found to underestimate obesity-related comorbidities more than TMI did.

31996898.takeaway: In boys with gynecomastia, the estradiol-to-testosterone ratio was higher than in pseudogynecomastia or healthy boys, and testosterone was lower than in pseudogynecomastia.

31996917.takeaway: In a 12-year prospective study, AIP-mutation-positive pituitary tumour patients found by testing had smaller lesions and needed fewer treatments than those who presented clinically.

31996919.takeaway: Across puberty in 84 youths, those with obesity had lower insulin sensitivity and higher acute insulin response than normal-weight peers at each pubertal time point.

31997554.takeaway: Of 40 children with persistent non-focal congenital hyperinsulinism, 55% could not be managed with medical monotherapy, 43% had surgery, and 78% still needed medical treatment at last follow-up.

31998235.takeaway: Mini-review of maternal photoperiodic programming, in which maternal pineal melatonin signals day length to the fetal hypothalamus, a mechanism described mainly in mammals.

31999620.takeaway: In 101 children with Down syndrome and subclinical hypothyroidism followed for five years, 35% with thyroid autoimmunity developed overt hypothyroidism versus 17% without it.

31999622.takeaway: In 1,475 normal-weight Chinese children, the CDKAL1 rs2206734 genotype predicted a metabolically obese, normal-weight phenotype, and it interacted with high birthweight.

32002540.takeaway: In 202 adults in a whole-room calorimeter, urinary norepinephrine was associated with 24-hour energy expenditure and sleeping metabolic rate.

32002552.takeaway: In 34 children with idiopathic subclinical hypothyroidism, baseline IQ matched 34 healthy controls, and two years of levothyroxine normalized TSH, from 6.3 to 2.8 mIU/L.

32003479.takeaway: In 177 adult women with Turner syndrome, quality of life was lower and perceived stress and fatigue higher than comparison values.

32003490.takeaway: Of 13 insulin pump systems tested, 0.1 U boluses ranged from -2% to +9% of target, and most pumps over-delivered early during 0.1 U/h basal rates.

32003515.takeaway: In Finnish children born 1987 to 2008, maternal diabetes carried a 6.4-fold higher risk of type 1 diabetes, with preterm birth and high birth length also linked to higher risk.

32003520.takeaway: In a pilot randomized trial of 39 teens with type 1 diabetes, a three-session sleep coaching intervention was feasible and well retained, with actigraphy showing improved sleep efficiency and duration.

32003523.takeaway: In 19 youths with type 1 diabetes and 18 controls aged 8 to 16, Go/No-Go task performance was the same, but the T1D group showed increased frontal-parietal network activation.

32004147.takeaway: In 200 Egyptian children with 21-hydroxylase CAH, older patients had lower quality-of-life scores, and the physical domain correlated with the degree of virilization.

32007996.takeaway: Exercise snacks were feasible in 12 adolescents with type 1 diabetes, associated with a 2.2% fall in body fat over three months and no change in glucose control.

32010059.takeaway: Review of cardiovascular risks and benefits of weight-loss medications for people with obesity, covering the neurohormonal pathways these drugs target.

32011043.takeaway: Sixteen expert health professionals gave qualitative recommendations to culturally adapt a validated diabetes education intervention for American Indian and Alaska Native teens to reduce gestational diabetes risk.

32013786.takeaway: In 300 patients with Hürthle cell change on thyroid fine-needle aspiration, the cells did not raise malignancy risk in most Bethesda categories.

32016164.takeaway: In 282 Australian adolescents, urinary hormones followed a stable trajectory in 63% of boys and 82% of girls, while the unstable group had larger swings and faster pubertal progression in boys.

32016362.takeaway: In a community cross-sectional study, 213 plasma lipid species were associated with HOMA-IR and 199 with insulin AUC during an oral glucose tolerance test.

32016383.takeaway: In 138 children with DSD, median AMH was 850 pmol/L in those with a normal testosterone response to hCG versus 54 pmol/L in those with a low response.

32016389.takeaway: In a nationally representative US sample of 8,562 adults, mean heart rate was higher in those with diagnosed diabetes (75 bpm), undiagnosed diabetes (75) and prediabetes (73) than in normoglycaemic adults (71).

32016427.takeaway: In 23 early postmenarchal girls, AMH stayed higher across the menstrual cycle than in 32 regularly cycling adult women.

32017012.takeaway: UK guidelines on perioperative glucocorticoid cover for primary and secondary adrenal insufficiency aim to identify affected patients and ensure they receive adequate supplementation.

32018348.takeaway: A novel homozygous INSR mutation (p.Leu260Arg) was found in an adolescent with type A insulin resistance syndrome, a phenotype usually linked to heterozygous variants.

32019329.takeaway: A virtual reality exposure to closed-loop insulin system barriers was feasible in 20 adults with type 1 diabetes; willingness to use VR was maintained in 90% and negative affect decreased.

32019854.takeaway: In this phase 3 randomized trial, reparixin did not improve C-peptide after islet transplantation for type 1 diabetes, so the authors do not support CXCR1/2 inhibition for this purpose.

32019856.takeaway: Autoantibody reversion occurred in 4.1% of multiple-autoantibody-positive TrialNet participants and was associated with a lower risk of progression to clinical type 1 diabetes.

32023623.takeaway: Among 1,067 children with chronic endocrine disease, 14% were lost to follow-up, with risk linked to older age at diagnosis, fewer recent visits, lower insurance class and isolated growth hormone deficiency.

32025718.takeaway: In 710 young Australian women, a self-assessed modified Ferriman-Gallwey score of 10 or more indicated excess body hair; androstenedione was the only androgen still associated with hair score after adjusting for age and BMI.

32027176.takeaway: Across 29 studies, pediatric telediabetes improved access and monitoring and, in some settings, short-term glycemic control; barriers included clinician workload and technical problems.

32027177.takeaway: In 46 parents of children aged 2 to 5 with type 1 diabetes, nighttime glucose checks disrupted sleep and lowered child quality of life; children using CGM had fewer sleep disturbances.

32027851.takeaway: In a nationwide cohort of about 2.3 million Israeli adolescents, high BMI at age 17 was associated with more cancer in later life, most clearly in men (adjusted HR 1.26 with adolescent obesity).

32029481.takeaway: In TEDDY children, reduced proline and branched-chain amino acids and other metabolite shifts preceded the first islet autoantibody, with different patterns for GAD-first and insulin-first autoantibodies.

32029638.takeaway: Prediction models estimated 10-year mortality and complication risk for adults with type 2 diabetes and obesity, with and without metabolic surgery, and were built into web and smartphone tools.

32030409.takeaway: After stopping androgen abuse, reproductive and cardiac function recovered over about 6 to 18 months, though testicular volume and SHBG stayed reduced.

32031055.takeaway: In 29 sporadic medullary thyroid cancers, RET was the only recurrently mutated cancer gene, FAT1 and FAT4 alterations were frequent, and two molecular subtypes differed in recurrence.

32031415.takeaway: Near-infrared light located the implanted Eversense glucose sensor in 24 of 30 adults within seconds; tattoos and heavy freckling at the site caused failures.

32034419.takeaway: In 11 patients born without a nose, men had signs of GnRH deficiency while some women had spontaneous breast development, suggesting GnRH neurons may not depend on olfactory structures.

32034440.takeaway: In 290 adults with type 1 diabetes using flash monitoring, preserved C-peptide was linked to less time in hypoglycemia, fewer low-glucose events and less glucose variability.

32038493.takeaway: Girls with idiopathic central precocious puberty had higher gut microbiota diversity and obesity-linked species than controls; 36 candidate microbial markers discriminated cases with AUC 0.95.

32038495.takeaway: In 3,080 expected poor ovarian responders, growth hormone adjuvant therapy did not significantly improve live birth rate in women under or over 35.

32041387.takeaway: Abnormal uterine bleeding in adolescents is most often due to anovulation; pregnancy, trauma, STIs and bleeding disorders must be excluded, and treatment ranges from observation to high-dose hormonal or IV therapy.

32041388.takeaway: Adolescent dysmenorrhea is often normalized and diagnosed late; NSAIDs are first line, with menstrual suppression, and endometriosis is treated by excision or ablation.

32041389.takeaway: Functional hypothalamic amenorrhea in adolescent girls is a diagnosis of exclusion, often linked to stress, weight loss or exercise; prolonged cases affect bone, metabolic and reproductive health and are managed with lifestyle change.

32041390.takeaway: Adolescents can use any contraceptive method; long-acting reversible methods are highly effective, and dual use with condoms is advised to prevent both pregnancy and STIs.

32041391.takeaway: For girls with disabilities, menstrual management should aim to reduce flow, pain and cyclic symptoms, since complete amenorrhea is hard to achieve and expectations need addressing.

32041392.takeaway: A 15-year-old girl with hypogonadism and coexisting medical conditions was evaluated for systemic hormone therapy, a setting where data on dosing and route are limited.

32041393.takeaway: In a case of complete androgen insensitivity with vaginal hypoplasia, non-surgical dilation was successful once the patient was emotionally ready, which the authors present as a first-line option.

32043185.takeaway: Children who progressed to type 1 diabetes or seroconverted without progressing had lower levels of most lipids and polar metabolites in the first year of life, with ceramide pathway changes tied to progression.

32043280.takeaway: Among 113 newborns with delayed TSH elevation, 93% recovered, mostly with transient hypothyroidism, and no reliable early parameter predicted permanent disease.

32049652.takeaway: In 197 children with phenylketonuria aged 1 to 22, two-thirds had dental caries and most had never seen a dentist, so regular dental visits are advised.

32049653.takeaway: In four patients with hereditary vitamin D-resistant rickets, intermittent peripheral IV calcium normalized PTH and ALP without complications, avoiding central catheter risks.

32049654.takeaway: Two novel GAA variants were found in two Pakistani families with infantile-onset Pompe disease, expanding the known mutation spectrum and supporting carrier testing and prenatal diagnosis.

32051920.takeaway: A 24-year-old woman with isolated 17,20-lyase deficiency from a homozygous CYB5A variant had normal female development, puberty and fertility, unlike other reported genetic females with this defect.

32052005.takeaway: In 30 children with CAH on hydrocortisone, a PK/PD model suggested that four-times-daily dosing better matches the cortisol circadian profile and avoids low levels than three-times-daily dosing.

32052034.takeaway: In 41 individuals from 15 Spanish families with autosomal dominant familial neurohypophyseal diabetes insipidus, AVP-NPII variants included four novel ones, all likely causing protein misfolding.

32052993.takeaway: The APA guideline strongly recommends family-based multicomponent behavioral interventions of at least 26 contact hours for children and adolescents aged 2 to 18 with obesity or overweight.

32054722.takeaway: About 5.5% of 1,036 FreeStyle Libre users developed cutaneous reactions and 3.8% allergic contact dermatitis to isobornyl acrylate; barrier films gave little benefit.

32059615.takeaway: The OneTouch Verio Reflect meter met FDA accuracy criteria for over-the-counter glucose meters across a wide glucose range, including extreme values.

32060549.takeaway: A 46,XX child with virilization carried a novel POR R550W variant that reduced aromatase, CYP17A1 and CYP21A2 activity, expanding the phenotype of POR deficiency.

32060556.takeaway: Biallelic loss-of-function TBC1D32 variants caused syndromic hypopituitarism in two Finnish siblings and a Pakistani proband, possibly by disrupting Shh signaling.

32061034.takeaway: In 46 children aged 2 to 5 with type 1 diabetes, 37% of parent feeding and child eating scores indicated problem behavior, and only 28% met HbA1c targets.

32061049.takeaway: Mean annual T1D care cost for 9,445 commercially insured US youths rose from $11,178 in 2012 to $17,060 in 2016, driven by insulin and technology costs.

32061050.takeaway: DNA methylation at probes near INS was associated with the INS variant rs689 and with type 1 diabetes in a nested case-control study, confirmed across two methylation platforms.

32064729.takeaway: In obese youth with type 2 diabetes in TODAY, HNF-MODY youth had worse beta-cell function than GCK-MODY youth, yet their insulin sensitivity improved most over 24 months.

32064911.takeaway: In 153 people without diabetes wearing CGM, exercise lowered sensor glucose by about 15 mg/dL, and nights after exercise had slightly lower nadir glucose.

32069066.takeaway: Four off-the-shelf insulin pumps underdelivered by up to 16% in bench testing, and accuracy varied by model and at the lowest basal rates.

32069232.takeaway: Two infants with Zellweger syndrome carried different homozygous missense variants, in PEX10 and PEX1, and both had severe disease with raised very-long-chain fatty acids.

32069233.takeaway: A 16-year-old with developmental delay and growth retardation had partial trisomy 9p and a 14q11.2 microduplication, with the 9p segment judged pathogenic.

32069234.takeaway: In 73 pubertal adolescents with overweight or obesity, 75% had high carotid intima-media thickness, and waist-to-height ratio was positively correlated with it.

32069235.takeaway: Among 1,070 Chinese adolescents aged 13 to 16, 37.9% had hyperuricaemia, which was about 4.6 times more common in overweight or obese students than in underweight ones.

32069236.takeaway: In 180 girls with obesity, higher erythrocyte EPA was linked to lower hyperandrogenemia risk, and free testosterone fell in the omega-3 supplemented group over 3 months.

32069237.takeaway: In 122 Iranian individuals tested for phenylketonuria, the most frequent PAH variants were c.1066-11G>A and c.143T>C, and variant spectra differed across populations.

32069238.takeaway: In children with celiac disease, Tanner stage was lower than in controls and correlated with gluten-free diet adherence, iron status, transferrin saturation and vitamin D status.

32069239.takeaway: A meta-analysis found lower serum vitamin D in children with precocious puberty than in controls, though the amount of supplementation needed remains uncertain.

32069240.takeaway: Urine Glc4 levels fell with age in healthy Turkish individuals, supporting age-based decision levels for diagnosing Pompe disease, especially late-onset.

32069241.takeaway: Among 80 children with disorders of sex development in Cameroon, 46,XX DSD was most common, mainly from congenital adrenal hyperplasia, and diagnosis was often late.

32069242.takeaway: In 122 very-low-birth-weight preterm infants, hyperthyrotropinemia occurred in about 1 in 8 after the first month without congenital hypothyroidism, and being small for gestational age was linked to it.

32069243.takeaway: In 50 children with Prader-Willi syndrome, sleep-disordered breathing, sleep initiation and maintenance problems and sleep hyperhidrosis were more common than in 112 controls.

32069244.takeaway: In 6,000 breastfed full-term newborns, blood glutamine plus glutamate, phenylalanine and tyrosine levels varied by birth weight, suggesting weight-specific screening references.

32069245.takeaway: In a survey of Pediatric Endocrine Society and POWER members, 19% prescribed weight-loss medication, metformin was most common, and response to drugs was often poor.

32069353.takeaway: Plasma glycated CD59 identified gestational diabetes before 20 weeks with an AUC of 0.86, and each unit rise was linked to 36% higher odds of a large-for-gestational-age infant.

32070246.takeaway: Levothyroxine in infants born before 28 weeks improved motor, language and cognitive scores at 42 months, but the authors judge the gains too small to change practice.

32070265.takeaway: In a fetal sheep model, late-gestation thyroid hormone deficiency caused white adipose tissue overgrowth and reduced UCP1 thermogenic capacity.

32072159.takeaway: Among 1,060 medullary thyroid cancer patients at four German centers, bone metastases were common, osteolytic lesions carried worse survival, and antiresorptive therapy reduced skeletal events.

32072184.takeaway: Among 6,280 patients referred for bone density testing, 11 had normocalcemic hyperparathyroidism, most with intermittent hypercalcemia; the authors see it as a mild form of primary hyperparathyroidism.

32072193.takeaway: In diabetic mice, Akap1 deficiency worsened cardiac function and mitochondrial dysfunction, and restoring AKAP1 expression alleviated diabetic cardiomyopathy.

32073311.takeaway: Among 666 children with type 1 diabetes, real-time CGM with a pump gave the highest time in range (61%) among non-automated strategies, with HbA1c of 7.3%.

32077755.takeaway: Parents of 79 children under 8 with type 1 diabetes mostly heard positive information about diabetes technology, mainly from their diabetes care providers and other families.

32078220.takeaway: In 51 Brazilian children and adolescents with new-onset type 1 diabetes, 41% reached partial remission within 3 months, and the DRB1*0301-DQB1*0201 haplotype was more common in those who did.

32079487.takeaway: Among 56 female survivors of childhood thyroid cancer, reproductive outcomes and AMH levels did not differ from controls, and cumulative radioiodine dose was not linked to AMH.

32079627.takeaway: In 8,261 patients with coronary artery disease, 41% of those screened by OGTT were dysglycemic, and only 58% of dysglycemic patients received all cardioprotective drugs.

32084003.takeaway: In Greek children treated for heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia, 69% reached the LDL-C target; male sex and lower baseline lipids predicted success, with no significant liver or muscle toxicity.

32084004.takeaway: In 343 adolescents, a higher dietary inflammatory index was associated with glucose intolerance (OR 3.5) and dyslipidemia (OR 5.3) in the highest quartile.

32084005.takeaway: In 30 women with juvenile gigantomastia, BMI and waist-to-hip ratio exceeded controls, while digit ratio did not differ, and the authors suggest prenatal sex hormones may affect timing.

32084277.takeaway: Two families with novel compound heterozygous SBP2 mutations had high T4, low T3 and high reverse T3 with reduced glutathione peroxidase activity, expanding the spectrum of this rare selenoprotein disorder.

32086287.takeaway: Monogenic diabetes was found in 3.5% of youth with diabetes in Lithuania and in 40.7% of antibody-negative patients; precision treatment changes succeeded in over half of eligible candidates.

32090426.takeaway: Among 423 young adults with type 1 diabetes, higher dispositional mindfulness was linked to lower HbA1c only in those aged 27 to 31, with a trend toward stronger effects after adverse childhood experiences.

32096009.takeaway: In about 286,000 South Australian children, maternal smoking in pregnancy was associated with 16% lower type 1 diabetes incidence, a non-significant estimate, and a negative-control analysis indicated residual confounding.

32098586.takeaway: Only 36% of 3,413 Uzbek households had adequately iodized salt, and women in households with non-iodized salt had markedly lower urinary iodine concentrations.

32098591.takeaway: SEER joinpoints in US thyroid cancer incidence from 1975 to 2016 coincided with American Thyroid Association guideline changes, suggesting guidelines shaped incidence trends in large part.

32099948.takeaway: In 78 children followed from age 1 to 6, DHEAS at age 1 correlated with DHEAS at age 6, and shorter birth length and rapid early length catch-up predicted higher DHEAS.

32104750.takeaway: In 15 children with 21-hydroxylase-deficient CAH and early puberty, histrelin slowed bone age advance and improved predicted adult height, though adult height stayed below midparental height.

32105513.takeaway: In 29 pediatric and young adult transplant patients, factory-calibrated CGM was safe and feasible, with 99% of paired values in clinically acceptable zones but a 20% mean relative difference.

32107930.takeaway: In post hoc subgroup analyses of the DUAL VII trial, IDegLira gave HbA1c reductions similar to basal-bolus insulin across adults with type 2 diabetes, with less hypoglycemia and more participants reaching the composite target.

32108022.takeaway: Among 443 adolescents with type 1 diabetes in a cardio-renal trial, statin and ACE inhibitor adherence was about 80% overall but fell over time, especially with older age and poorer glycemic control.

32108902.takeaway: In 151 pregnant women, urinary glucocorticoid excretion rose from the second to the third trimester, and higher excretion was associated with higher offspring birth weight z scores.

32109207.takeaway: In 40 boys undergoing inguinoscrotal surgery, estrogen receptor expression in the appendix testis was significantly lower in unilateral cryptorchidism than in controls, with a trend toward lower androgen receptor expression.

32109208.takeaway: Two newborns with elevated tyrosine on screening each carried a heterozygous HPD variant, suggesting HPD may not be strictly autosomal recessive in its pathogenic effects.

32110744.takeaway: A novel TBX1 frameshift variant in a family of four caused congenital hypoparathyroidism, deafness and facial asymmetry without cardiac involvement, widening the phenotype of TBX1 variants.

32110745.takeaway: In 188 children tested with ACTH stimulation, a baseline 17OHP of 6 nmol/L or more by LC-MS/MS screened best for nonclassic CAH, with 96% sensitivity and specificity.

32112702.takeaway: A 15-year-old boy with Graves' disease developed adrenal crisis two weeks after starting carbimazole, revealing autoimmune polyglandular syndrome type II, a rare combination in children.

32112703.takeaway: In 227 obese Mexican children and adolescents, 70% had insulin resistance, and adolescents with vitamin D insufficiency or deficiency had higher insulin and HOMA-IR.

32115635.takeaway: In 116 premenopausal women, spotting before menses was linked to slower luteal-phase pregnanediol glucuronide decline, so the first bleed is the best marker for the end of the luteal phase.

32115641.takeaway: This review covers androgen physiology and treatment from fetal life through adolescence, and notes that long-term placebo-controlled trials are needed to set the age, route and dosing of testosterone.

32117044.takeaway: Osteogenesis imperfecta care is multidisciplinary; bisphosphonates raise BMD, but their effect on fracture risk is uncertain, so trials with fracture endpoints are needed.

32117048.takeaway: The kinship theory of imprinting proposes that maternal-gene biases drive metabolic disease risk through low birth weight, reduced beta-cell mass and early puberty, while paternal-gene biases favour rapid catch-up growth.

32117055.takeaway: Among 1,201 obese children, 61% were metabolically unhealthy, and uric acid, HOMA-IR and waist-to-height ratio independently predicted that status.

32117064.takeaway: Maternal blood MFSD2a was lower in gestational diabetes and correlated with placental MFSD2a and neonatal head circumference in the first six months, suggesting a possible marker of DHA transport.

32117065.takeaway: Two Italian patients with Berardinelli-Seip lipoatrophy had novel homozygous AGPAT2 variants, showing heterogeneous presentation and cardiovascular assessment that is hard to make.

32118268.takeaway: In 108 healthy subjects, the larger fall in energy expenditure during fasting reflected higher expenditure during feeding rather than lower fasting metabolic rate, challenging the thrifty phenotype view.

32119790.takeaway: In a randomized trial of adolescents, initializing Control-IQ with total daily insulin settings was safe, and time in range was similar to home settings, with a non-significant trend to more lows at camp.

32125891.takeaway: Insulin pens outperform syringes for dosing accuracy, and half-unit pens allow finer doses that may help insulin-sensitive people with type 1 diabetes reach tighter control.

32126013.takeaway: In 142 children with autoimmune thyroid disease, Graves' and Hashimoto's differed in treatment duration and relapse, and thyroglobulin antibodies were positive in 75% of girls with a maternal history.

32126014.takeaway: In 65 mother-newborn pairs, cord blood leptin was higher in neonates of mothers with high gestational weight gain, but only among male newborns.

32126015.takeaway: Across 160 Iranian studies including 481,070 students aged 6 to 20, obesity prevalence was 11% and overweight 12%, with obesity highest in elementary school students.

32126138.takeaway: In 139,702 Colorado newborns, macrosomia raised C3 and C18:1 acylcarnitine levels, making those screening markers two to three times more likely to exceed cutoffs and causing more false positives.

32126889.takeaway: In 146 healthy term neonates, reference intervals for free T4 and TSH were set at days 3 to 7 and 13 to 15, with free T4 lower limits of 20.5 and 15.3 pmol/L.

32129057.takeaway: Two adolescents with primary hyperparathyroidism presented with posterior reversible encephalopathy from severe hypercalcemia; parathyroid adenoma excision resolved calcium levels and neurological symptoms.

32131709.takeaway: In metastatic medullary thyroid cancer, a mean tumor doubling time of one year or less predicted shorter survival: median 11.1 vs 16.5 years for doubling times of one to three years.

32132006.takeaway: In 88,424 adults with diabetes, Black, American Indian and Pacific Islander respondents reported more daily foot checks than White respondents, while Asian and Hispanic respondents reported fewer.

32132008.takeaway: In 797,318 Swedish children, antibiotic prescriptions in the first year of life were associated with higher type 1 diabetes risk before age 10 (HR 1.19), mainly for otitis media and respiratory infections.

32132974.takeaway: Hypothalamic-pituitary antibodies were found in 49% of 63 children treated for brain tumors and in none of 50 controls, most often in those with germinoma.

32134536.takeaway: Youth in the Indian YDR registry had higher HbA1c than US SEARCH youth for both type 1 and type 2 diabetes, and used pumps far less often (1.5% vs 16.2% with type 1).

32134539.takeaway: Among 477 Australian adolescents with type 1 diabetes, disordered eating was linked to depression, anxiety, diabetes distress and body dissatisfaction, with diabetes distress the strongest predictor.

32134541.takeaway: In 80 children with type 1 diabetes, Black children had higher HbA1c than White children, but iron indices did not explain the difference after adjusting for mean glucose.

32134542.takeaway: In 124 patients with circadian rhythm sleep-wake disorder, 26% had impaired glucose tolerance, and shorter total sleep time was associated with higher 2-hour glucose.

32134735.takeaway: In a national survey of Iranian students aged 7 to 18, 4.9% had subclinical zinc deficiency, and age- and sex-specific serum zinc percentiles were established.

32139383.takeaway: Among 56,818 US adults, 70% were screened for diabetes, with clinic-level screening ranging from 51% to 92%, only partly explained by patient and provider factors.

32139385.takeaway: Rapid corneal nerve fiber loss of 6% or more per year occurred in 17% of 590 people with diabetes and was more common in those with baseline neuropathy.

32139388.takeaway: Among 25,283 Danish and Finnish individuals, high childhood BMI raised type 2 diabetes risk only when adult obesity was also present, a pattern unchanged by education, smoking or activity.

32139596.takeaway: In beta-cell and human islet experiments, substituting proinsulin Tyr-B16 weakened the dominant-negative effect of a mutant, restoring wild-type insulin export and insulin production.

32140727.takeaway: In 40 women with PCOS, saturated fat ingestion increased NF-κB activation and CRP compared with lean controls, and NF-κB activation correlated with lower insulin sensitivity and higher androgen secretion.

32140730.takeaway: In 703 healthy Norwegian girls aged 6 to 16, ultrasound and Tanner breast staging agreed well (kappa 0.87), with ultrasound showing thelarche slightly earlier; menarche had fallen 2.8 months over a decade.

32145029.takeaway: Among 177 craniopharyngioma patients, 18% had fractures, more often in men (26% vs 8%), and very low BMD did not reliably predict fracture risk.

32145058.takeaway: A Turkish patient with type B pyruvate carboxylase deficiency reached ammonia levels of 860 μmol/L despite treatment and needed dialysis; a novel 12-bp deletion was identified.

32146441.takeaway: In 34 overweight adolescents, MR fat fraction correlated moderately with ALT and AST and with ultrasound fatty liver grades, while ultrasound sensitivity for NAFLD was 81% and specificity 50%.

32148169.takeaway: Among 34,184 asymptomatic Chinese women, breast masses and thyroid nodules were associated with each other, with breast masses found in 18.6% and nodules in 35.6%.

32150253.takeaway: In a three-generation familial hypocalciuric hypercalcemia type 1 family, a novel loss-of-function CaSR variant was found in hypercalcemic members, while an infant with neonatal hypocalcemic seizures did not carry it.

32152136.takeaway: In a matched nationwide cohort of adults with type 2 diabetes and obesity, gastric bypass lowered heart failure (HR 0.33) and cardiovascular death (HR 0.36) more than nonfatal cardiovascular events (HR 0.82).

32152632.takeaway: A woman with complete estrogen insensitivity from an ESR1 variant did not develop secondary sexual characteristics on diethylstilbestrol despite high estrogen levels, suggesting other receptor mechanisms.

32153499.takeaway: Six eGFR equations gave widely different values in 36,782 children with type 1 diabetes, and all showed poor agreement with measured urinary creatinine clearance.

32153511.takeaway: In 55 children with sellar lesions presenting with central diabetes insipidus, germ cell tumors were most common (74.5%), and 91% had anterior pituitary dysfunction, most often of growth hormone.

32153512.takeaway: Targeted exome sequencing found likely pathogenic variants in hypothalamic-circuit genes in 8% of 92 children with early-onset severe obesity, including a novel MC4R frameshift in two unrelated patients.

32154561.takeaway: In 213 patients with adrenal adenomas, lower sclerostin tracked with mild autonomous cortisol secretion, and bone turnover markers rose after adrenalectomy.

32157854.takeaway: In 133 children treated with rhGH, mean final height SDS was -1.8, and first-year height gain was the strongest predictor of final height.

32157855.takeaway: Among 241,083 Turkish newborns screened for CAH, 20 cases were diagnosed, and the two-tier program caught all salt-wasting cases (sensitivity 100%).

32157856.takeaway: Sirolimus appeared to control hypoglycemia in two patients with nonketotic hypoinsulinemic hypoglycemia caused by AKT2 or PTEN mutations.

32158430.takeaway: This review describes how estrogen receptors and aromatase shape male gonadotropin regulation and testicular development from infancy to late puberty, drawing on human and mouse data.

32158432.takeaway: The 19-item patient and 16-item parent BAR-GHT questionnaires, validated in 156 children and 146 parents, reliably measure barriers to growth hormone injections across six domains.

32160304.takeaway: In 314 pairs of Chinese girls, variants rs5780218 and rs708910 raised the risk of central precocious puberty, while rs932491 was linked to lower risk of early, fast puberty.

32161050.takeaway: US adult DKA and hyperglycemic hyperosmolar state rates rose steeply from 2009 to 2015 in both emergency and inpatient settings, with DKA mostly in young adults with type 1 diabetes.

32163150.takeaway: High sodium intake suppressed aldosterone and serum calcium while raising calciuria in 18 participants, and urinary sodium of 220 mEq/day or more was linked to higher kidney stone risk in cohorts.

32163719.takeaway: Among 411 adolescents with type 1 diabetes, cost and insurance concerns (61%) and wear-related hassles (58.6%) were the most common barriers to pump and CGM use.

32163723.takeaway: In analyses of CGM trial data, mean absolute glucose best distinguished individuals with type 1 diabetes, and percent time in the 70 to 180 mg/dL range was the optimal time-in-range metric.

32166332.takeaway: Among 5,658 pregnant women with normal HbA1c, each 1% rise was linked to higher odds of preterm birth (OR 1.58) and macrosomia (OR 1.70).

32170297.takeaway: In 641 Chinese participants without known diabetes, saliva 1,5-anhydroglucitol alone had modest accuracy, but combined with fasting glucose it cut the number needing an OGTT by 47%.

32170311.takeaway: A polygenic score built from 10 novel SNPs predicted familial short stature in 1,163 Han Chinese participants from Taiwan, with an AUC of 0.94 in the testing group.

32170320.takeaway: In 153 patients with congenital hyperinsulinism, KATP channel mutations explained 82% of mutation-positive cases, and no transient CHI patients carried pathogenic variants.

32170323.takeaway: Continuous intravenous hydrocortisone was the only delivery mode that consistently matched cortisol levels seen under major stress.

32172310.takeaway: In pancreas samples taken soon after type 1 diabetes onset, proinsulin processing was aberrant in children diagnosed under age 7 but much less so in those aged 13 and older, supporting age-related endotypes.

32172603.takeaway: Among 892 Colorado Medicaid youths with type 1 diabetes, 20% used CGM after coverage began, and combined pump and CGM users had lower HbA1c than those using neither.

32173956.takeaway: A cumulative index of missed care elements in a pediatric type 1 diabetes program fell 26% after 12 months of tracking, showing that a quality metric can drive program change.

32174888.takeaway: This review links birth mode, diet and antibiotic use to gut microbiota changes and to type 1 diabetes autoimmunity, noting that patients often have less diverse microbiota.

32179891.takeaway: Across 22 studies of 21,801 participants, adolescents' self-assessed Tanner stages agreed moderately to substantially with clinician assessment, and agreement improved when stages were grouped into pre-, during and post-puberty.

32180760.takeaway: Higher plasma prolactin at 10 to 14 weeks of pregnancy was linked to higher gestational diabetes risk, with adjusted odds rising to 2.33 in the top quartile.

32181896.takeaway: Among 118 SDHx mutation carriers, 51% developed pheochromocytoma or paraganglioma, and those diagnosed by genetic screening had smaller tumors and fewer metastases than those diagnosed clinically.

32181961.takeaway: In 305 pediatric DKA episodes, new-onset type 1 diabetes took longer to resolve than episodes in known type 1 diabetes, at 20 versus 12 hours to bicarbonate of 15 or more.

32181971.takeaway: Hyperfiltration was more common in children with type 1 diabetes than with overweight or obesity (28% vs 10%), while in obese children higher uric acid, older age and puberty were linked to lower GFR.

32183608.takeaway: An iodine-containing prenatal multiple micronutrient raised maternal iodine status and lowered thyroglobulin during pregnancy, but the benefit faded postpartum and infant iodine status stayed inadequate for six months.

32183609.takeaway: In a survey of 2,454 thyroid cancer patients, 4.1% reported recurrent and 5.8% persistent disease, with advanced tumor stage and nodal involvement linked to both.

32185376.takeaway: Finnish patients with APECED had about 11 times the expected mortality, highest for endocrine and metabolic causes (SMR 570) and for oral and esophageal cancers (SMR 170).

32187014.takeaway: This review summarizes NAFLD in patients with obesity, its link to insulin resistance, and management by removing causes, lifestyle change, drug therapy and weight-loss surgery.

32187575.takeaway: Diagnostic accuracy of overnight or first-morning urine metanephrines did not differ from 24-hour urine collections in 706 patients tested for pheochromocytoma or paraganglioma.

32187608.takeaway: In 96 healthy children and 31 women, MEPE changed with age and was higher during pregnancy, while intact FGF-23 showed no significant age-related change.

32188373.takeaway: In 51,795 adults in a national study, the prevalence of metabolic disorders followed a U-shaped curve with urinary iodine, lowest at 300 to 499 μg/L.

32193573.takeaway: A consensus core outcome set for GDM prevention and treatment trials was built through systematic review, a three-round Delphi study and a consensus meeting, and includes 14 maternal and neonatal outcomes.

32194501.takeaway: In 59 children with overweight or obesity compared with 20 lean controls, ultrasound showed early cardiac and carotid changes, including higher left ventricular mass, thicker carotid walls and impaired strain.

32194504.takeaway: This review argues that osteoporosis has developmental origins, with peak bone mass shaped by childhood growth, sexual maturation, nutrition and physical activity.

32194506.takeaway: The author argues that increased dietary protein in human evolution raised DHEAS and linked meat consumption to brain development during the 5-to-8 transition, a hypothesis calling for research.

32196874.takeaway: Youth type 1 diabetes incidence was about four times higher in the US SEARCH registry (21.2 vs 4.9 per 100,000) than in Indian registries, and type 2 incidence was far higher in the US.

32198197.takeaway: This review describes asprosin, a fasting-induced hormone that raises glucose and appetite, and notes that anti-asprosin antibodies reduced blood glucose, appetite and body weight in studies.

32201902.takeaway: In 30,697 Swedish men, earlier age at peak height velocity predicted higher adult type 2 diabetes risk, independent of childhood BMI.

32203961.takeaway: Three children from consanguineous Kurdish families carried novel homozygous KATP channel variants causing congenital hyperinsulinism, a probable explanation for earlier unexplained neonatal deaths.

32204686.takeaway: Two novel THRA missense variants reduced TRα1 affinity for T3, and corepressors stayed bound to the mutant receptors in the presence of T3, explaining the severity of thyroid hormone resistance.

32206806.takeaway: In a birth cohort of 264 adolescents, low maternal plasma vitamin B12 during pregnancy was linked to greater offspring cortisol responses to a stress test.

32208390.takeaway: In 14 children with hyperinsulinism wearing a Dexcom G5, CGM detected hypoglycemia with 86% sensitivity, but its positive predictive value was only 50%, so it is not reliable alone for hypoglycemia.

32209645.takeaway: In the CONCEPTT trial, women with type 1 diabetes using real-time CGM had lower glucose for about 7 hours a day than with self-monitoring, and women with large-for-gestational-age infants ran higher glucose profiles.

32211773.takeaway: Serum INSL3 by LC-MS/MS rose from near the detection limit in prepubertal boys to a peak in young men, and baseline INSL3 predicted the testosterone response to hCG better than baseline testosterone.

32212580.takeaway: Among 226 children with DSD assessed over 20 years, most 46,XX patients were recommended female rearing (90%), while 46,XY patients were most often recommended male (61%), the hardest group to assign.

32212919.takeaway: A short-term somatostatin analogue test distinguished TSH-secreting adenomas from thyroid hormone β resistance, with 95% sensitivity and 94% specificity in the training cohort, confirmed in a validation cohort.

32212971.takeaway: Starting a hybrid closed-loop system did not significantly change sleep in 37 adolescents with type 1 diabetes or their parents, although adolescent satisfaction with glucose monitoring rose significantly.

32215353.takeaway: In 254 high-risk children at a prediabetes clinic, 25.6% had impaired glucose tolerance and 6.7% type 2 diabetes, but 37% of those with IGT or T2D did not return for follow-up.

32218770.takeaway: Adult height correlated strongly across countries with indicators of quality of life and social conditions, including life expectancy, GDP and homicide rates, in 1992 to 1996 national data.

32219303.takeaway: In 167 patients after thyroid lobectomy for papillary cancer, thyroglobulin and its dynamics did not predict recurrence, so serum Tg alone has limited value for follow-up.

32219330.takeaway: In 249 adults with recent-onset type 2 diabetes, holotranscobalamin and folate levels were similar with and without short-term metformin, and were not linked to insulin sensitivity overall.

32222056.takeaway: In 48 pediatric endocrinology fellows, an online spaced-education curriculum on insulin pumps or CGMs raised knowledge scores from about 30 to 35% to about 61%.

32224610.takeaway: In 15 GH-deficient prepubertal boys compared with 15 controls, the distal radius cortical perimeter was smaller, while volumetric density and estimated bone strength did not differ.

32227565.takeaway: Among 128 families of 5- to 9-year-olds with new type 1 diabetes, 54% reported at least one stressful life event in the first year, linked to coping, parental depression and family conflict.

32228152.takeaway: Obesity was associated with thyroid cancer (OR 1.72), and the association was stronger for BRAF-mutated papillary cancers than for BRAF-negative ones (OR 1.71).

32228164.takeaway: In 15 patients under 20 with follicular thyroid carcinoma, 53% had DICER1 variants, four with DICER1 syndrome, and none had RAS or TERT variants.

32228167.takeaway: As a first-line test in 212 patients with 248 thyroid nodules, core needle biopsy cut inconclusive results to 10.9%, with 100% successful biopsies and no major or delayed complications.

32229598.takeaway: Applying the 2017 AAP blood pressure criteria raised hypertension prevalence in 74,677 youths with type 1 diabetes to 44.1%, compared with 26.5% under the 2004 report.

32229667.takeaway: A Turkish patient with compound ABCB4 mutations and progressive familial intrahepatic cholestasis type 3 had very high cholestanol, suggesting high cholestanol may be another marker of PFIC3.

32229668.takeaway: Over six months in adolescent swimmers, bone formation markers osteocalcin and P1NP fell in both the vibration and swimming-only groups, while osteocalcin rose in control youths.

32229669.takeaway: Three children with GLUD1-related hyperinsulinism/hyperammonaemia showed variable courses, from late presentation to spontaneous resolution of hypoglycemia by age 8 in one.

32229670.takeaway: In 93 children with septic shock, nonthyroidal illness was common (87%), and lower T4 on admission was independently associated with in-hospital mortality, with a cutoff of 58.71 nmol/L.

32229671.takeaway: In 240 healthy Nigerian term neonates, anogenital distance correlated with serum testosterone (r = 0.425), suggesting a cheap, non-invasive way to estimate testosterone.

32229672.takeaway: This review finds that childhood obesity is linked to subtle ECG changes, such as longer P-wave duration and dispersion, that stay within normal ranges, unlike the pathological changes seen in obese adults.

32229673.takeaway: In 170 children with type 1 diabetes, high oxidative stress markers were predicted by proatherogenic lipids, metabolic control and renal markers.

32229729.takeaway: Among 166 parents seeking subspecialist care for short stature, height comparisons weighed more heavily than for primary-care parents, and 76% expected growth hormone to improve quality of life.

32231642.takeaway: In 20 young Mexican-American men, eight weeks of combined exercise improved insulin sensitivity similarly whether or not they had a family history of type 2 diabetes.

32232324.takeaway: Central adrenal insufficiency was excluded in 81 of 82 adults with Prader-Willi syndrome, so it is rare in this group.

32232325.takeaway: Germline CDKN1B loss-of-function variants were found in five of 211 Cushing's disease patients, mostly children, and all tested variants destabilized the protein.

32232399.takeaway: In 16 children with delayed puberty, a kisspeptin-stimulated LH rise of 0.8 mIU/mL or more predicted later puberty, while a response of 0.4 or less predicted none.

32234720.takeaway: Among 6,323 US adults with diabetes in NHANES, use of any glucose-lowering medication rose from 58% in 2003–04 to 67% in 2015–16, with metformin and insulin analogs increasing and sulfonylureas declining.

32236416.takeaway: In 98 people with type 1 diabetes, PD-1 and PD-L1 expression on T cells was lowest before partial remission and restored during it, but not in nonremitters.

32237015.takeaway: In 115 children with overweight or obesity, higher cardiorespiratory fitness was linked to less liver fat and lower gamma-glutamyl transferase.

32238606.takeaway: Two novel GNPTAB variants, a nonsense and a missense change, were found in compound heterozygous form in a Pakistani family with mucolipidosis II.

32238607.takeaway: Among 118 patients with DSD followed by a multidisciplinary team, 31% had a psychiatric diagnosis, most often ADHD (15%).

32238608.takeaway: A 17-year-old with type 1 tyrosinemia had a successful pregnancy on nitisinone and a healthy, developing child, though tyrosine rose after delivery.

32242235.takeaway: A consanguineous Turkish family's novel truncating MCM8 variant caused primary ovarian insufficiency with growth retardation and pilomatricomas, with chromosomal breaks in the patient's cells.

32245343.takeaway: In 8- to 10-year-old children in Shanghai, the goiter rate stayed under 5% at median urinary iodine of 27 to 277 μg/L, and the authors propose 70 to 277 μg/L as the optimal range.

32245799.takeaway: In 962 Swedish children with new type 1 diabetes and 636 controls, three HLA-DQ amino acid residues captured the full type 1 diabetes risk association of the DQ8 and DQ2.5 haplotypes.

32248673.takeaway: A 7-year-old girl with pycnodysostosis had combined GH deficiency, and rhGH raised her height by 1 SD over two years while unmasking central hypothyroidism.

32249474.takeaway: Interviews with 40 public school nurses found enthusiasm for diabetes devices tempered by inconsistent training, poor pre-school planning and policy barriers to integrating devices into schools.

32249476.takeaway: Across 66,071 children with type 1 diabetes in eight high-income countries, mean HbA1c ranged from 7.6% to 8.8%, but rose by a similar 0.7% from the youngest to the oldest age groups.

32252210.takeaway: This review describes bone morbidity after pediatric acute lymphoblastic leukemia, driven by the disease, glucocorticoids and treatment, and lists calcium, vitamin D, pyrophosphate analogues and exercise as options.

32252211.takeaway: Children with chronic gastrointestinal diseases face higher risks of low bone density, osteoporosis and fractures, and the authors call for routine DXA evaluation of those at high risk.

32252212.takeaway: Children with neurological disorders such as epilepsy, cerebral palsy and Duchenne muscular dystrophy have high osteoporosis risk from inactivity, poor nutrition and drugs such as antiepileptics.

32252213.takeaway: In 69 girls with central precocious puberty treated with a GnRH agonist, those born small for gestational age reached menarche sooner after treatment (12.5 vs 21.1 months), with similar final height.

32252214.takeaway: In 69 children with idiopathic short stature treated with rhGH for one year, the -202 A/C IGFBP-3 genotype did not change IGF-1, IGFBP-3 or growth velocity.

32252215.takeaway: In 19 children and adolescents aged 10 to 19, the proinsulin-to-C-peptide ratio was higher in recent-onset type 1 diabetes than in controls (6.24% vs 1.46%), and higher still in the younger participants.

32252216.takeaway: Four patients from three Saudi families with neonatal diabetes shared a homozygous INS promoter variant (c.-331C>G), a probable important cause of neonatal diabetes in Saudi Arabia.

32252217.takeaway: A 17-month-old Korean boy with normal genitalia had nonclassic congenital lipoid adrenal hyperplasia from compound heterozygous STAR mutations, and hyperpigmentation was the key diagnostic clue.

32252218.takeaway: An 18-year-old with Prader-Willi syndrome and respiratory failure from morbid obesity lost substantial weight with severe calorie restriction, growth hormone and liraglutide, reaching a BMI of 50.8.

32252219.takeaway: Three children with congenital hypothyroidism developed persistent or recurrent goiter after normal thyroid glands in normal position, and all carried DUOXA2 mutations.

32252220.takeaway: A 24-month-old Korean boy with familial hypophosphatemic rickets carried a novel hemizygous PHEX missense variant, also found in his mother, who had short stature and genu varum.

32253999.takeaway: This 35-year review supports long-term antithyroid drug therapy for Graves' disease, which is effective and safe in children and adults and often keeps euthyroidism for years after stopping.

32256447.takeaway: This review of self-monitoring in pediatric type 1 diabetes emphasizes CGM and the factors affecting its accuracy and real-world use, alongside ketone monitoring.

32256449.takeaway: Among 6,861 women with GDM in southern Han China, higher fasting OGTT glucose (5.1 mmol/L or more) raised the odds of hypertensive disorders, preterm birth, neonatal hyperbilirubinemia and macrosomia.

32256453.takeaway: Among 25 children with congenital hyperinsulinism and feeding problems, 64% needed tube feeding at diagnosis, falling to 12% by three years, while feed aversion resolved slowly and faster after lesionectomy.

32258957.takeaway: Cord blood A-FABP was higher in the smaller of growth-discordant dichorionic twins than in their co-twins (109 vs 73 ng/mL), but this difference was not seen in monochorionic twins.

32259819.takeaway: In 504 girls, high DHEAS at age 7 predicted earlier thelarche, pubarche and menarche and higher androgens during puberty, though polycystic ovarian morphology was similar to controls.

32265838.takeaway: In 212 rural Gambian infants, the infancy-to-childhood growth transition occurred at about 9 months, earlier than the roughly 12 months seen in UK infants, suggesting an accelerated rather than delayed transition.

32265840.takeaway: In 32 SGA infants, those with intrauterine delay of bone maturation had greater first-year height velocity and better height gain at 12 months than SGA infants with adequate bone maturation.

32265844.takeaway: Galanin receptor 3 expression was tied to high-grade glioma, while pituitary adenomas showed little galanin or receptor expression.

32265846.takeaway: In 150 patients with severe obesity who had gastric bypass or sleeve surgery, adolescents lost more weight than adults and had greater resolution of type 2 diabetes (87.5% vs 54.8%) and hypertension.

32265847.takeaway: In men with alcohol use disorder after one month of abstinence, plasma leptin rather than nesfatin-1 was related to craving, and leptin, IL-6 and CRP were higher than in healthy men.

32267057.takeaway: Hong Kong childhood type 1 diabetes incidence was 4.3 per 100,000 a year in 2008 to 2017, nearly double the previous registry's 2.2, although the annual rise has slowed in children under 15.

32267248.takeaway: A macrosomic neonate with congenital hyperinsulinism from compound heterozygous ABCC8 mutations responded to diazoxide, unusual for biallelic ABCC8 disease.

32270202.takeaway: In 763 adolescent and young adult cancer survivors, ovarian function depended on treatment gonadotoxicity and age: AMH rose and plateaued after low or moderate treatment but stayed lower after highly gonadotoxic therapy.

32271383.takeaway: In 4,832 children followed to about age 11, maternal obesity and gestational diabetes were each linked to childhood adiposity, and together they raised the odds of obesity about sixfold.

32273272.takeaway: In 27 adults with transient neonatal diabetes, relapse age tracked with age at puberty, and socioeducational attainment was lower than in the general population.

32277561.takeaway: Among 1,225 adolescents with type 1 diabetes, 6% of quarterly PHQ-9 teen screens were positive, and 60% of positive screens came from patients with no documented depression diagnosis.

32277567.takeaway: Among 125 children with new-onset type 1 diabetes, the 43% who were physically active had more partial remission at two years (44% vs 13%) and lower insulin requirements.

32282051.takeaway: A novel NPR-B deletion caused gain-of-function signaling in a family, with tall stature and macrodactyly of the great toes in the mother and her daughters.

32282052.takeaway: Ovarian endometrioma lesions in adults showed more extensive fibrosis and progression than those in adolescents, supporting the view that endometriomas progress over time.

32284450.takeaway: In a 16-week randomized trial of 40 children aged 8 to 14 with type 1 diabetes, combined resistance and aerobic training reduced anxiety and improved quality of life.

32285111.takeaway: In a matched cohort of 1,496 pregnant women in China, maternal blood zinc was inversely linked to birth weight in gestational diabetes, while cord blood zinc was positively linked.

32285124.takeaway: In a Swedish case-control study of 11,213 hyponatremia admissions, newly started ACE inhibitors and calcium channel blockers carried higher odds of hospitalization, while ongoing use showed no elevated risk.

32291442.takeaway: Among 424 Chinese patients with 21-hydroxylase deficiency, 59 carried the TNXA/TNXB chimera, and those with it had far more Ehlers-Danlos features (71% vs 27%).

32294191.takeaway: Among 116 children with NF1 and optic pathway gliomas, 28% had endocrine dysfunction before treatment, most often central precocious puberty, and hypothalamic involvement was the only independent predictor.

32295321.takeaway: SHOX variants were found in 15 of 46 Turkish patients with skeletal findings with or without short stature, including three point mutations and one whole-gene deletion.

32295325.takeaway: In 7,921 Pakistani children aged 5 to 14, neck circumference correlated strongly with BMI (r = 0.61), and sex- and puberty-specific cut-offs were proposed for overweight and obesity.

32297630.takeaway: Indian cancer registry data showed thyroid cancer incidence rising from 2006-08 to 2012-14, with overdiagnosis estimated at 51% of cases in women and none found in men.

32300791.takeaway: Adrenal steroidogenesis fell rapidly in the first weeks after replacement began in newly diagnosed autoimmune Addison disease, and 16% of 37 long-standing patients had residual adrenal function.

32301148.takeaway: Across 321 acute-illness attendances by children with CAH, patient-initiated stress dosing was associated with lower potassium, with no significant change in sodium, glucose or hypotension.

32301182.takeaway: Across 26 studies of emerging adults with type 1 diabetes, parents generally supported self-care and emotional wellbeing, though their support could also feel ambivalent or intrusive.

32301201.takeaway: Among parents of 2,088 five-year-olds in a type 1 diabetes risk study, 67% reported no anxiety, while mothers of autoantibody-positive children were more anxious (OR 2.21).

32301241.takeaway: In 22 UK health professionals, nurses preferred home management at diagnosis for the family connection it allowed, while consultants worried it could strain relationships with families.

32301999.takeaway: In 90 children aged 7 to 11, more time in moderate-to-vigorous activity was linked to better insulin sensitivity, after adjusting for prenatal exposure to maternal obesity or GDM.

32302086.takeaway: A 3-year-old boy with a novel TRPM6 variant had hypomagnesemia with secondary hypocalcemia and seizures, and persistent low magnesium was managed with oral magnesium oxide.

32302499.takeaway: Two new-onset type 1 diabetes patients, one adult and one child, were managed safely by telemedicine after in-person initial education, using CGM reports and digital follow-up.

32303157.takeaway: This historical profile recounts Deborah Doniach's work with Ivan Roitt showing that Hashimoto's thyroiditis is autoimmune, with antibodies targeting thyroglobulin and thyroid peroxidase.

32304129.takeaway: In 4,244 Danish children with type 1 diabetes, HbA1c rose after severe hypoglycemia, peaking two to three years later, with about 4 mmol/mol of deterioration in those with two or more episodes.

32304131.takeaway: In children with type 1 diabetes and controls, serum cystatin C predicted microalbuminuria with an AUC up to 0.98, and combining it with urinary cyclophilin A improved prediction.

32304132.takeaway: Australian childhood type 1 diabetes incidence averaged 25.0 per 100,000 person-years from 2002 to 2017, with a five-yearly cyclical pattern and a decline among children aged 0 to 4.

32304144.takeaway: In youth with type 1 diabetes, each SD rise in LDL cholesterol raised the odds of elevated arterial stiffness 1.28-fold, but the link lost significance after adjusting for waist-to-height ratio or insulin sensitivity.

32304158.takeaway: Among 234 children aged 6 to 11 in Al Ain, UAE, metabolic syndrome rose with obesity severity, from 4.5% in normal-weight to 30.0% in obese children.

32304307.takeaway: Expanded newborn screening by tandem mass spectrometry in Beijing from 2014 to 2019 confirmed 16 inborn errors of metabolism, a birth prevalence of about 1 in 3,666, mostly organic acidemias.

32306417.takeaway: In 442 patients tested for primary aldosteronism, women aged 20 to 39 had higher aldosterone-to-renin ratios than men, supporting age- and sex-specific reference ranges.

32306477.takeaway: In a crossover trial of 43 youths and adults with type 1 diabetes, faster aspart was absorbed earlier than insulin aspart at every age, and anti-insulin antibodies had no clear link to meal glucose outcomes.

32309857.takeaway: In Mexican children, a genetically higher haptoglobin level was causally linked to childhood obesity in Mendelian randomization analysis.

32311027.takeaway: In a four-generation family with dominant hypophosphatemic rickets, affected members carried heterozygous mutations in both SLC34A1 and SLC34A3, with phosphate wasting that tracked gene dosage.

32311039.takeaway: Sixteen probands with heterozygous IHH variants, including the first reported complete IHH deletion, showed mild short stature or fifth-finger shortening rather than classic brachydactyly type A1.

32311120.takeaway: Vaginal microbiome diversity was higher in 39 women with newly diagnosed PCOS than in 40 controls, with lower Lactobacillus crispatus abundance in the PCOS group.

32312859.takeaway: Across five diabetes cardiovascular outcome trials with 46,606 participants, women were 28% to 36% of enrollees and less often received statins, aspirin and beta-blockers.

32314478.takeaway: Among 4,184 overweight adolescents screened with HbA1c, those found to have prediabetes showed a greater decline in BMI z-score slope than those with normal HbA1c, by about 0.023 per year.

32315399.takeaway: In 479 Singaporean mother-child pairs, higher maternal fasting glucose in pregnancy was linked to thicker carotid intima-media in children at age 6, and to higher arterial stiffness in boys.

32315507.takeaway: In 291 parental couples of youth with type 1 diabetes, mothers' illness intrusiveness predicted later intrusiveness in both parents, and three distinct couple patterns emerged over four years.

32315515.takeaway: This review argues that CGM accuracy at low glucose and its calibration algorithms limit its use for hypoglycemia in children with hyperinsulinism, while predictive algorithms may help prevent neuroglycopenia.

32316012.takeaway: Among 336 obese youth referred with prediabetes, the screening HbA1c category was the strongest predictor of dysglycemia at follow-up, with prediabetes seven times more likely in those with higher initial HbA1c.

32318024.takeaway: In one patient with globozoospermia, calcium ionophore activation after round-headed sperm injection gave a lower fertilization rate than donor sperm, yet produced a euploid blastocyst and a healthy baby.

32318025.takeaway: This review describes the fetal and infant HPG axis, with gonadotropin surges around 1 to 3 months of life, and notes that the role of minipuberty in programming later reproductive function in girls is uncertain.

32318648.takeaway: Four 46,XX children with suspected aromatase deficiency carried novel CYP19A1 variants, all but one with loss of function, and two girls had ambiguous genitalia at birth.

32321731.takeaway: In 1.46 million Israeli adolescents, severe obesity carried a type 2 diabetes hazard ratio of about 26 in men and 45 in women, and higher BMI meant earlier diagnosis.

32327420.takeaway: Presymptomatic type 1 diabetes screening in Denver cost $4,700 per case detected versus $14,000 with routine screening, and reaching cost-effectiveness required about 20% fewer DKA events at diagnosis.

32328033.takeaway: Thyroglossal duct cysts were found on ultrasound in 4.4% of 2,885 adults, with no significant overall link to a history of radioactive iodine therapy.

32329372.takeaway: A dynamic adsorption model suggests up to 80% of an insulin dose can be lost to infusion sets in the first hour of pump therapy, so extra care is needed early, especially in children.

32332156.takeaway: In rodent and human beta cells, lactogens protected against ER stress through JAK2/STAT5 signaling, and placental lactogen expression in Akita mice reduced hyperglycemia and diabetes incidence.

32333449.takeaway: Among 4,555 Indian people diagnosed with diabetes before age 20, 71% had type 1 diabetes and 20% type 2 diabetes, with microvascular complications tracked over follow-up.

32333480.takeaway: In the DPV registry, epilepsy was not more frequent in GAD antibody-positive children with type 1 diabetes, while hypoglycemia with coma was linked to epilepsy.

32333631.takeaway: The DISABKIDS quality-of-life modules were valid in Denmark, Sweden and Norway, but scores were not directly comparable across the three countries, so benchmarking needs adjustment.

32333632.takeaway: In 1,057 European adolescents aged 12 to 18, four lipoprotein lipase gene variants were associated with BMI, triglycerides and cholesterol ratios, and physical activity modified some associations.

32333767.takeaway: In a nationwide Taiwanese cohort, relatives of nonmedullary thyroid cancer patients had much higher risk, with relative risk about 20 in twins and 6.4 in siblings, and genetics estimated at 28% of susceptibility.

32335987.takeaway: In 367 Brazilian adolescents with type 1 diabetes, genomic ancestry and self-reported color-race did not influence glycemic control after adjustment.

32337961.takeaway: In 80 children with idiopathic GH deficiency, 55% had normal GH on retesting at mid-puberty and stopped treatment with similar final height, and IGF-1 after one year predicted GH sufficiency.

32344414.takeaway: New clinical criteria based on sitting height and arm span identified SHOX haploinsufficiency, including enhancer deletions, with 99% sensitivity.

32344415.takeaway: Two patients with isolated ACTH deficiency from homozygous TBX19 variants, one novel, presented with neonatal hypoglycemia and convulsions that resolved on hydrocortisone.

32345653.takeaway: In type 1 diabetes with asymptomatic celiac disease, a gluten-free diet did not change HbA1c but increased postprandial glucose, and celiac seropositivity was 6.8% in adults and 4.7% in children.

32345654.takeaway: In 4,761 ALSPAC offspring, genetic liability to adult type 2 diabetes was linked to metabolic traits from age 8, with patterns shifting from lipid differences at 8 to branched-chain amino acids at 18.

32348954.takeaway: In 1,381 healthy Danish children, parental pubertal timing predicted offspring pubertal milestones mainly for offspring of the same sex.

32348991.takeaway: In 170 females aged 12 to 25, PCOS was not an independent predictor of bone mineral density, whereas obesity and insulin resistance were.

32349463.takeaway: A 9-year-old girl with Turner syndrome developed a fibroma of the tendon sheath during growth hormone treatment, raising the question of whether GH contributes to this tumor.

32349464.takeaway: Resistance to thyroid hormone alpha can mimic hypothyroidism with normal TSH, and low reverse T3 or mildly raised creatine kinase in children should prompt THRA sequencing.

32349465.takeaway: In 30 girls with premature thelarche under 3 years, 17% reached a peak LH above 10 IU/L on GnRH stimulation, and 67% exceeded 5 IU/L.

32349530.takeaway: In 845 Indian children and adolescents followed for a median of 7 years, dysglycemia developed at 20.2 per 1,000 person-years among those with normal glucose tolerance at baseline.

32349628.takeaway: In a meta-analysis, thyroid hormone levels (free T4 and T3) were more often associated with clinical outcomes than TSH was.

32349990.takeaway: In 225 severely obese children from consanguineous Pakistani families, 49% carried pathogenic point mutations or CNVs in monogenic obesity genes, and 59% of cases likely had a discrete genetic cause.

32350890.takeaway: Among 12 women with hypoparathyroidism over 17 pregnancies, active vitamin D needs changed by more than 20% in over half, and 36% developed hypercalcemia by late pregnancy or early lactation.

32352398.takeaway: In 550 adolescent girls given 50,000 IU of vitamin D weekly for nine weeks, serum vitamin D rose from 6.4 to 35.6 ng/mL and anti-Hsp27 antibody titers fell.

32354697.takeaway: In 4,699 US adults with diabetes, eating relatively more energy and protein at dinner than at breakfast was associated with higher diabetes-related mortality.

32354857.takeaway: In Japanese macaques, maternal obesity with a Western-style diet reduced insulin-stimulated glucose uptake in fetal and juvenile offspring muscle.

32357109.takeaway: In a 2x2 randomized trial of 301 teens with type 1 diabetes, neither problem-solving nor text reminders changed HbA1c over 12 months compared with usual care.

32362871.takeaway: A meta-analysis found endothelial function impaired early in type 1 diabetes (SMD -0.61), with smooth muscle function also impaired (SMD -0.32).

32362873.takeaway: Among 412 pregnant women, postpartum thyroiditis occurred in 15%, with risk ranging from 3.8% to 100% across history-based groups, and seafood consumption helped separate risk.

32362875.takeaway: Among 382 children with autoimmune thyroid disease, girls predominated, and most cases occurred in puberty, with Hashimoto's more common early in puberty and Graves' later.

32364020.takeaway: In 214 pregnant women in Rio de Janeiro, urinary iodine of 250 μg/L or more independently raised the risk of gestational diabetes (RR 2.9) and hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (RR 4.6).

32364223.takeaway: Adrenoleukodystrophy causes adrenal insufficiency in over 80% of patients, and this review covers transplantation, gene therapy and newborn screening, which has found novel variants of uncertain significance.

32368952.takeaway: In 660 children followed to age 6, serum perfluorononanoic acid was inversely associated with TSH, with sex-specific links for other PFAS, while free T4 and T3 at age 6 showed positive relationships with some PFAS.

32368954.takeaway: Routine chest CT at presentation for cT1aN0 papillary thyroid cancer showed abnormalities in 32.6% of 1,000 patients, mostly benign, and did not identify distant metastasis.

32370663.takeaway: Ultrasound detected radioiodine-related salivary gland damage in 143 of 570 patients treated for papillary thyroid cancer.

32373071.takeaway: CDK4 was overexpressed in 62% of 40 adrenocortical carcinoma samples, which makes it a candidate for CDK4/6 inhibitor therapy.

32373772.takeaway: A girl with a paternally inherited 6q24 duplication had transient neonatal diabetes, and microarray later showed a larger 14 Mb duplication, showing why broader genetic testing is needed.

32373773.takeaway: A man with Hartsfield syndrome and a novel de novo FGFR1 variant, followed from age 1 to 31, showed changing posterior pituitary function and a bone metabolism disorder.

32376986.takeaway: This review of KATP channel structures explains how activating mutations cause neonatal diabetes and why sulfonylureas are now the primary therapy for it.

32379496.takeaway: In a pilot randomized trial of 80 parents of adolescents with type 1 diabetes, a strengths-based app was feasible, and parents used it for about 106 days on average.

32379699.takeaway: COVID-19 guidance for adrenal insufficiency stresses sick-day education, emergency injection kits, and oral stress-dose hydrocortisone of 20 mg every 6 hours during acute infection.

32380822.takeaway: A 3-year-old Chinese girl with dysmorphism, growth retardation and intellectual disability had an 8.1 Mb 6q25.1-q25.3 microdeletion, supporting microarray testing in similar patients.

32382745.takeaway: In a phase 3 randomized trial of 222 hypogonadal men, 87% in both the oral testosterone undecanoate and topical testosterone groups reached eugonadal average testosterone levels.

32382815.takeaway: Across 13 countries, 29.9% of 59,000 children with new-onset type 1 diabetes presented in DKA, with the lowest prevalence in Sweden and Denmark and the highest in Luxembourg and Italy.

32386308.takeaway: In 241 children undergoing hypospadias repair, preoperative topical promestriene did not reduce healing complications compared with placebo (14.9% vs 16.4%, P = 0.86).

32388508.takeaway: In 28 patients with McCune-Albright syndrome followed for 12 years, six developed gastrointestinal polyps around median age 23, and platelet storage pool deficiency required transfusion during surgery in five of eight affected patients.

32389062.takeaway: Sixty percent of 121 children and young adults with type 1 diabetes reported skin complications from CGM or insulin pump devices, more often among those using both (OR 2.9).

32390939.takeaway: This review asks whether bone in children with obesity is unhealthy, noting that fat favors marrow adipogenesis over bone formation but also provides mechanical load that supports bone accrual.

32392277.takeaway: A PFN1 frameshift variant caused early-onset polyostotic Paget-like disease across three generations, and carriers needed repeated zoledronate infusions for bone pain and remission.

32392278.takeaway: In six people with congenital leptin deficiency, leptin replacement raised fatty acids, acylcarnitines and bile acids within a month, consistent with enhanced lipolysis and fatty acid oxidation.

32392622.takeaway: A meta-analysis of 14 controlled studies found that GnRH agonist treatment of early puberty in girls raised adult height by about 3.2 cm, with the benefit linked to treatment duration.

32394691.takeaway: A boy with hypoglycemia and adrenal insufficiency without adrenal antibodies was diagnosed with adrenoleukodystrophy, and transplantation after cerebral involvement led to normal development.

32396189.takeaway: At about 9 years, the body composition and cardiometabolic measures of 326 children did not differ by maternal thyroid treatment, but mothers left untreated for suboptimal thyroid function had higher BMI.

32403178.takeaway: In 28 monozygotic twin pairs, differences in cord blood IGF-I predicted differences in final height, with discordant twins ending about 7.9 cm apart.
