32404350.takeaway: In neonatal mice, deleting the m6A regulators Mettl3 and Mettl14 impaired beta-cell maturation through MafA mRNA stability, and reduced expression was also seen in islets of patients with type 2 diabetes.

32409491.takeaway: In mice, dexamethasone given in late pregnancy reduced fetal brown fat development through increased Ppargc1a promoter methylation, leaving offspring with insulin resistance, adiposity and cold sensitivity.

32410303.takeaway: Among 94 patients with bilateral pheochromocytoma at Mayo Clinic, 80% had a genetic disease, most often MEN 2A, and most synchronous tumors were treated with simultaneous bilateral adrenalectomy.

32410305.takeaway: In 128 families of children aged 5 to 9 with new type 1 diabetes, parental hypoglycemia worry rose over 18 months, and baseline parental depression modified that trajectory.

32410329.takeaway: Among 343 youth with diabetes seen at an eye center, retinopathy was found in 3.8%, and none with HbA1c below 8% had it.

32410357.takeaway: Diabetes incidence in Austrian children under 15 rose steadily until about 2012, driven by the youngest age group, then leveled off, with type 1 diabetes making up 94% of cases.

32411089.takeaway: Among 29 women with PCOS and 29 BMI-matched controls, 15 microRNAs differed after false discovery correction, and none were linked to BMI, androgens, insulin resistance or AMH.

32411094.takeaway: Two Danish MEN 2A patients with RET L790F, diagnosed with medullary thyroid cancer at ages 14 and 70, had no germline RET variant explaining the difference; a somatic FLT3 variant was found.

32413117.takeaway: Children with nephropathic cystinosis had an 11-fold higher risk of short stature, bone deformities or skeletal surgery than CKD controls, despite Fanconi syndrome treatment.

32413135.takeaway: In 206 adolescents aged 8 to 14, medium-chain acylcarnitines were inversely associated with insulin resistance, with sex-specific metabolite patterns linked to BMI z-score.

32413843.takeaway: Heterozygous aggrecan mutations can cause isolated short stature with advanced bone age, so genetic evaluation of children with idiopathic short stature may identify monogenic causes.

32413848.takeaway: Spot urine metanephrine ratios correlated closely with 24-hour urine outputs in 3,143 specimens from 2,416 patients, supporting spot urine as a practical alternative for pheochromocytoma screening.

32418261.takeaway: In 31 children with celiac disease and islet autoimmunity at diagnosis, a gluten-free diet was associated with decreased or disappearing islet autoantibodies in 71%.

32418262.takeaway: Children with type 1 diabetes enrolled in 2019 ate more protein and fat and less carbohydrate and fiber than those enrolled in 2009, and their HbA1c was lower.

32418263.takeaway: In a systematic review of 502 neonatal diabetes cases from KATP channel mutations, transfer from insulin to sulfonylurea succeeded in 91% with KCNJ11 and 86.5% with ABCC8 variants, with response varying by genotype.

32418266.takeaway: Among 192 Danish youths aged 11 to 19 with type 1 diabetes, 21% had disordered eating, including 34% of girls versus 9% of boys, and those affected had higher BMI z-scores.

32418302.takeaway: In a pilot randomized trial of 21 youths on multiple daily injections, an algorithm that adjusted insulin doses achieved time in target similar to physician adjustments (39.5% vs 38.4%), with 92% of its changes accepted.

32418308.takeaway: Among 125 children with type 1 diabetes, those with two foreign-born parents had more DKA at onset and higher HbA1c, and reported different quality-of-life scores than children of Italian parents.

32418334.takeaway: In 158 youth with overweight or obesity, visceral fat was the fat compartment most strongly linked to oxidative stress, and higher vitamin D was associated with lower oxidative stress in those with more visceral fat.

32418360.takeaway: Among 37 children with monogenic diabetes at a South Indian centre, 15 had neonatal diabetes, five had MODY, and 13 had Wolfram syndrome.

32419140.takeaway: Among 508 Chilean girls, 37 (7.3%) had transient thelarche, and they more often entered puberty through pubarche (51% vs 23%).

32419214.takeaway: In 26 women with MEN 1 across 96 pregnancies, hyperparathyroidism occurred in 16 pregnancies, and gestational diabetes was far more common than the Australian average (56% vs 8.9%).

32421355.takeaway: In 13 youths using hybrid closed-loop systems, time in range stayed good through the Italian COVID-19 lockdown and was higher during full lockdown (72%) than during partial restrictions (66%).

32421787.takeaway: In 63 girls with Turner syndrome treated with GH dosed by IGF-1 titration, only 6% had supranormal IGF-1 levels, at a median dose of 33 μg/kg/day.

32421827.takeaway: Three novel pathogenic HMGA2 variants were found in five patients from three Silver-Russell syndrome families, including homozygosity in a severely affected sibling pair, while heterozygous parents were mildly affected.

32422605.takeaway: In 36 boys with non-palpable testes, serum AMH, inhibin B, FSH and hCG-stimulated testosterone cut-offs were derived to tell functional testicular tissue from anorchia.

32424540.takeaway: Higher average weight z-scores in each childhood growth period predicted type 2 diabetes incidence in 2,100 American Indian participants followed for up to 25 years, with rate ratios of about 1.7 to 2.1 per SD.

32424871.takeaway: A compound heterozygous TPO mutation in a 23-year-old Chinese woman with congenital hypothyroidism was analysed functionally, and structural modelling predicted damage to the enzyme.

32425882.takeaway: In 50,019 adults followed for ten years, mean BMI rose under age 60 and fell in older adults, while estimated body fat rose at all ages.

32425884.takeaway: Among 377 congenital hypothyroidism cases, DUOX2 variants were most common (21%), with DUOXA2 more prominent in thyroid dysgenesis and DUOX2 in gland-in-situ cases.

32428920.takeaway: TRPC4AP variants were found in patients with thyroid dysgenesis, including a de novo stop codon, and knockdown in Xenopus tadpoles reduced thyroid anlage volume.

32430458.takeaway: In 463 children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes, insulin glargine 300 U/mL matched glargine 100 U/mL for HbA1c reduction at week 26, confirming noninferiority.

32430905.takeaway: Among 121 UK patients referred for hereditary hyperparathyroidism testing, a pathogenic germline variant was found in 16%.

32430977.takeaway: In 85 at-risk children followed in ENDIA, fecal elastase fell over time in those who developed islet autoimmunity, sometimes before autoantibodies appeared.

32431136.takeaway: In 14 children with iatrogenic Cushing syndrome from potent glucocorticoids, 12 had adrenal insufficiency at presentation, and HPA axis recovery took a median of 60 days.

32431137.takeaway: In 124 adolescents, serum DEHP and MEHP did not differ between 63 with PCOS and 61 controls, so these phthalates did not separate the groups.

32431667.takeaway: In five pinealectomized patients, three months of melatonin raised vagal heart-rate-variability measures, including RMSSD and high-frequency power.

32431668.takeaway: Among 251 girls with central precocious puberty who had detailed brain MRI, 75.7% had no brain abnormality, and 24.3% had hypothalamic or pituitary findings.

32431669.takeaway: A systematic review of 10 studies found that children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes tended to have more severe periodontal disease than healthy peers.

32432211.takeaway: Among 81 French children with pheochromocytoma or paraganglioma, 10-year event-free survival was 39%, while overall survival was 97%.

32433752.takeaway: In people without CAH who were exposed to dexamethasone in early pregnancy, HOMA-β was lower than in 75 controls, mainly in girls, with no overall effect on lipids.

32434441.takeaway: Among 41,911 pregnant women screened in early pregnancy in Shanghai, isolated maternal hypothyroxinemia was associated with a higher risk of preterm birth (OR 1.32).

32435230.takeaway: An overweight adolescent girl with very high DHEAS but no adrenal tumor had a heterozygous steroid sulfatase nonsense variant, with a transporter defect suggested as a mechanism.

32436858.takeaway: In 133 patients with GH deficiency, the pons ratio on pituitary MRI was higher than in 47 controls, and a cut-off of 0.27 gave 71% sensitivity and 56% specificity.

32436859.takeaway: A 3.5-month-old infant with extreme hypertriglyceridemia was diagnosed with glycogen storage disease type Ia from a homozygous G6PC variant.

32436860.takeaway: A 36-year-old with type 1 diabetes had drug-refractory focal epilepsy linked to elevated GAD-65 autoantibodies in serum and cerebrospinal fluid, with epilepsy diagnosed a decade before diabetes.

32436861.takeaway: Two siblings with neurofibromatosis type 1 presented at ages 6 and 7 with cyclical vaginal bleeding and prepubertal GnRH responses, consistent with isolated premature menarche.

32436948.takeaway: An 18-year-old woman developed subacute thyroiditis 15 days after a mild SARS-CoV-2 infection, the first such case reported.

32436949.takeaway: Serum chromogranin A was raised in 66% of people with neuroendocrine tumors, 39% with type 1 diabetes, 38% with autoimmune gastritis and 24% with autoimmune polyendocrinopathy.

32436958.takeaway: Whole-genome sequencing found two novel GNAS deletions in pseudohypoparathyroidism type 1A, one of which reduced methylation of the exon A/B region, identifying a new region that affects imprinting.

32436961.takeaway: In 363 young adults born SGA, metabolic and bone outcomes after GH with or without two years of GnRH analogue were similar over five years after GH cessation, although fat mass rose in both groups.

32439825.takeaway: Among 50 people with type 1 diabetes who carried the protective HLA-DQB1*06:02 allele, average HbA1c at diagnosis was 10.8%, showing that they failed this genetic protection.

32441669.takeaway: A 12-year-old Jamaican girl first diagnosed with type 1 diabetes was found to have type A severe insulin resistance from a novel heterozygous INSR missense variant.

32441670.takeaway: Among 177 girls with precocious puberty, basal LH, estradiol and pelvic ultrasound measures identified rapidly progressive central precocious puberty, with diagnostic power rising as abnormal parameters accumulated.

32441671.takeaway: Children with type 1 diabetes had thicker epicardial fat and longer P-wave, QT and Tp-e dispersion than 41 matched healthy children, suggesting early cardiac conduction changes.

32442282.takeaway: A three-question telephone screen identified PCOS with 89% sensitivity and 78% specificity in community women aged 14 to 45.

32445735.takeaway: In 147 young adults with early type 2 diabetes, an intensive lifestyle programme with diet replacement cut body weight by about 6 kg more than usual care at 12 months.

32445737.takeaway: In an individual-participant meta-analysis of 48,145 mother-child pairs, maternal subclinical hypothyroidism was associated with higher risk of small-for-gestational-age infants (11.8% vs 10.0%).

32447329.takeaway: In 1,171 obese adolescents aged 10 to 16, the triglyceride/HDL ratio identified metabolic syndrome more accurately than HOMA-IR (AUC 0.849 vs 0.689).

32447330.takeaway: A 12-year-old girl with Prader-Willi syndrome and diabetes improved glycemia with an SGLT-2 inhibitor combined with a GLP-1 agonist after growth hormone was stopped.

32447331.takeaway: Among 85 Turkish patients with urea cycle disorders, classical citrullinemia was most common and had the highest mortality, and higher peak ammonia was seen in patients who died.

32447332.takeaway: Among 3,524 Korean children born full term, 13.4% were born SGA, and those who had not caught up made up 36.4% of children with short stature; shorter parental heights predicted SGA birth.

32447333.takeaway: Among 34 Chinese patients with mucopolysaccharidosis III, speech delay and intellectual disability were universal, with 19 having type IIIB and 14 type IIIA.

32447334.takeaway: Expanded newborn screening of 220,443 infants in Tianjin identified 25 fatty acid oxidation disorders (1 in 8,817), most often primary carnitine deficiency at 1 in 20,040.

32447335.takeaway: In 532 obese children, a 1-hour OGTT glucose of 155 mg/dL or more was linked to a less favorable lipid profile, even among children with normal glucose tolerance.

32447336.takeaway: Among 24,321 German and Austrian children with new type 1 diabetes, about 19% presented in DKA, and these children were treated at centers closer to home regardless of center size.

32447804.takeaway: In 200 Colombian families with type 1 diabetes, a RNASEH1 variant (rs7607888) was associated with the disease and interacted with HLA tagSNPs.

32448901.takeaway: In 36 patients with MEN2B, diffusion abnormalities were found in 94%, and diffusion capacity declined by about 2.9% per year.

32449692.takeaway: Thyroid cancer after childhood cancer, in 31 survivors matched to 93 sporadic cases, tended to be smaller and more often bilateral, and 46% were found by surveillance neck palpation.

32451572.takeaway: Among 27,935 people with type 1 diabetes in Scotland, crude mortality before age 50 fell from 2004 to 2017, but standardized mortality stayed about three to four times that of the general population.

32453405.takeaway: In 271 low-risk thyroid cancer patients not given radioiodine, thyroglobulin correlated with TSH over follow-up, so Tg changes need to be read alongside TSH.

32454486.takeaway: In 10 patients with hypopituitarism and eyelid anomalies, three had FOXL2 mutations, all with typical BPES, and their pituitary deficits ranged from isolated GH deficiency to complete deficiency.

32457058.takeaway: In 80 TrialNet participants followed through diagnosis, C-peptide stayed stable until about six months before type 1 diabetes was diagnosed and then declined.

32457700.takeaway: A woman with genetically confirmed Carney complex and ACTH-independent hypercortisolism was treated with metyrapone, which prolonged her pregnancy by five weeks, and her newborn needed hydrocortisone for transient hyponatremia.

32459310.takeaway: In pediatric papillary thyroid cancer, extracellular-vesicle PD-L1 correlated with clinical features and contributed to suppression of T cells.

32459320.takeaway: Targeted sequencing of 167 congenital hypothyroidism cases found variants in 66.5%, but 68.5% of those variants were of unknown significance.

32460296.takeaway: Among 46 patients with craniopharyngioma followed for a median of 12.8 years, the share with at least one affected pituitary axis rose from 54% at presentation.

32460688.takeaway: A standardized map of iodine status across Europe was built by postharmonizing urinary iodine data from 40 studies in 23 countries against a gold-standard laboratory.

32468610.takeaway: A three-generation pedigree with the GCK p.Leu122Val variant supports its pathogenicity and provides the first phenotype description for this variant in MODY.

32469330.takeaway: In 136 Japanese infants with congenital hypothyroidism, sequencing gave a likely molecular diagnosis in 19%, most often from biallelic DUOX2 variants, while 23% carried single variants in recessive genes.

32469331.takeaway: In 23 children with obesity but no hypertension, circulating chemerin correlated with systolic blood pressure load on 24-hour monitoring (r = 0.5).

32469332.takeaway: In 17,066 Turkish newborns screened by tandem mass spectrometry, the authors established local acylcarnitine and amino acid cut-offs for 26 inborn errors of metabolism.

32469333.takeaway: Serum soluble α-Klotho was significantly lower in 46 children with type 1 diabetes than in 78 controls under age 12.

32469429.takeaway: Of 87,815 US pediatric DKA admissions from 2010 to 2014, 4.6% were followed by an all-cause readmission within 30 days.

32471808.takeaway: Among 29 patients with painful diabetic neuropathy, those with an irritable nociceptor phenotype were 8.7 times more likely to respond to intravenous lidocaine.

32471809.takeaway: Children with type 1 diabetes performed worse on a working memory task than 47 controls and showed greater brain activation modulation, which was linked to better performance and earlier diagnosis.

32471909.takeaway: During an induced hyperglycemic clamp, 20 adolescents with type 1 diabetes had lower spatial working memory capacity than during euglycemia.

32471910.takeaway: In 109 people with type 1 diabetes, switching from predictive low-glucose suspend to closed-loop control raised time in range by 5.9 percentage points over three months.

32476492.takeaway: A machine learning model using CGM data from 112 patients predicted hypoglycemia with over 91% sensitivity and over 90% specificity at 30- and 60-minute horizons.

32477268.takeaway: This review asks whether myelin deficits in MCT8 deficiency are delayed or permanent, noting that case reports suggest delayed myelination while post-mortem and MRI studies suggest persistent white matter abnormalities.

32477270.takeaway: Among 1,720 youths aged 5 to 25 with overweight or obesity in a US health system, anti-obesity medications were often used off label, since only two are FDA-approved for children.

32479603.takeaway: In 586 short children born preterm and treated with GH in the KIGS database, height SDS gained 1.82 over GH treatment in those born appropriate for gestational age.

32480405.takeaway: In 16 girls with idiopathic central precocious puberty, two (13%) carried whole-gene MKRN3 deletions, both paternally inherited, and one had no typical Prader-Willi features beyond obesity.

32482020.takeaway: In an infant with ABCC8-related congenital hyperinsulinism who still had severe hypoglycemia after subtotal pancreatectomy, sirolimus markedly improved glycemic control, and it was stopped at 15 months.

32483683.takeaway: Across 90 prominent type 2 diabetes trials with 268,978 participants, mean age was 63 years, so adults aged 18 to 39 with early-onset disease were severely underrepresented.

32486989.takeaway: A girl with congenital hypothyroidism was homozygous for a novel frameshift in SLC26A7, predicted to be nonfunctional, pointing to this thyroid anion transporter in dyshormonogenesis.

32487778.takeaway: In 86 adults tested for suspected nonclassic 21-hydroxylase deficiency, baseline serum steroids measured by mass spectrometry were used to find markers that discriminate the disorder without cosyntropin stimulation.

32492708.takeaway: PMN-MDSCs were increased in the blood of patients with papillary thyroid cancer, and in cell experiments they promoted invasion of thyroid cancer cells by repressing miR-486-3p.

32495721.takeaway: In 93 pediatric papillary thyroid carcinomas, 55.9% carried a gene fusion, most often involving RET, NTRK or ALK, and five of the fusions were novel.

32496604.takeaway: In 43 very-low-birth-weight infants, those with transient hypothyroxinaemia of prematurity had a delayed TSH decline after TRH stimulation, with a 180-minute to baseline TSH ratio of 3.0 vs 1.3.

32497228.takeaway: In 19 people given first-trimester dexamethasone for CAH risk but without CAH, brain imaging at ages 16 to 26 showed enlarged amygdalae and altered white matter diffusivity compared with 43 controls.

32498089.takeaway: In 590 adults aged 18 to 97, serum 11-ketotestosterone and 11-ketoandrostenedione stayed stable with age in women but declined in men.

32498666.takeaway: Eighteen hypothyroid patients aged 3 to 59 kept elevated TSH despite rising levothyroxine doses, and their hormone ratios were compared with those of thyroid hormone receptor-β resistance.

32499384.takeaway: In 77,925 Chinese adults in the 4C cohort, fetal-period famine exposure was linked to higher diabetes risk (RR 1.17), while childhood exposure was not significantly linked.

32501499.takeaway: The C allele of HCP5 variant rs3094228 was overrepresented in 469 UK Graves' disease patients (OR 1.76), with a stronger association in young-onset disease.

32501612.takeaway: In youth with type 2 diabetes in the TODAY trial, MCP-1 rose and VCAM fell over one to three years, while ICAM and E-selectin rose with HbA1c, with no treatment-group differences.

32502242.takeaway: At clinical diagnosis of type 1 diabetes, Hispanic children in TrialNet had more DKA (44.7% vs 25.3%) and higher ZnT8 autoantibody positivity than non-Hispanic whites.

32503005.takeaway: In 68 women with PCOS and BMI of 27 or more, a behavioural programme did not change global well-being at four months, though the intervention group had less anxiety and depressed mood.

32506065.takeaway: A female infant with 3β-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase type 2 deficiency and Bartter syndrome type 3 had both conditions from maternal uniparental isodisomy, a combination not previously reported.

32506132.takeaway: In 317 Danish girls with median age 16.1 years, 6.3% had oligomenorrhea, and the study describes reproductive hormone and ovarian imaging values in a general population.

32506592.takeaway: Among 31,861 children with type 1 diabetes in the German DPV registry, 12,326 received psychological care, and those who did had higher HbA1c and more DKA, with HbA1c stable after care began.

32506728.takeaway: Among 235 poorly controlled Indian children with type 1 diabetes, dyslipidemia prevalence was 47.2%, with poor glycemic control and higher TSH as predictors.

32506739.takeaway: Among 3,456 emerging adults with type 1 diabetes, African American and Hispanic participants less often took snack boluses and checked glucose with a meter than non-Hispanic whites.

32508309.takeaway: Childhood cancer survivors who develop secondary thyroid cancer have no specific management guidance, so prior treatment toxicities should shape the choice of thyroid cancer therapy.

32508745.takeaway: This review asks whether genetic testing helps classify delayed puberty, noting that genes such as IGSF10 and FTO have been linked to self-limited delayed puberty in some families.

32517539.takeaway: Among 98 children treated for differentiated thyroid cancer, 19% had lung metastasis, mostly found within six months of thyroidectomy, and metastasis was more common in children under 13.

32519829.takeaway: A mother and two sons with a COL1A1 variant of uncertain significance had prenatal bone deformities and early nontraumatic fractures that stopped after infancy, a previously unrecognized osteogenesis imperfecta pattern.

32521075.takeaway: GH measured in dried newborn screening cards separated 25 newborns with severe GH deficiency (median 3.9 μg/L) from 281 healthy newborns, which may enable early diagnosis.

32522029.takeaway: In parents of five- to nine-year-olds with recent-onset type 1 diabetes, starting CGM reduced hypoglycemia-avoidance behaviors but did not reduce hypoglycemia worry.

32522039.takeaway: Among 233 adults with type 1 diabetes using CGM in the DPV registry, those aged 30 and older had higher time in range (54% vs 49%) and less time above range than younger adults.

32525525.takeaway: In a crossover trial of 20 healthy adults, a late dinner at 22:00 caused nocturnal glucose intolerance and reduced fatty acid oxidation compared with an 18:00 dinner.

32525982.takeaway: In 920 newborns, principal component analysis raised the positive predictive value of 21-hydroxylase deficiency screening from 20.0% to 66.7% in a retrospective comparison with the current algorithm.
